1000.name: 弹力带单腿反向提踵
1000.englishName: band single leg reverse calf raise
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带放在脚掌周围。
抓住稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。

1001.name: 弹力带单腿分腿蹲
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
右脚向前迈一大步，左脚向后退一小步。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行，保持左膝盖略高于地面。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

1002.name: 弹力带仰卧直腿抬高
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
将带子放在脚弓周围，并用手握住带子的末端。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，直到它们垂直于地板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1003.name: 弹力带深蹲划船
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
弯曲膝盖并蹲下，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
从蹲姿开始，将弹力带手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1004.name: 弹力带深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，弹力带放在膝盖上方。
保持挺胸、核心收紧，将臀部向后推，弯曲膝盖，形成下蹲姿势。
确保膝盖位于脚趾上方，并且重量位于脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1005.name: 弹力带站姿卷腹
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住弹力带并将其举至胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1006.name: 弹力带后三角肌划船
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.

1007.name: 弹力带站姿扭转卷腹
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在上背部，穿过胸前。
用手握住带子的末端，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌并将躯干向一侧扭转，将肘部移向另一侧的膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1008.name: 弹力带踏阶
instructions: 将一条带子绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
面向台阶或平台站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
用右脚踩上平台，用脚后跟推动。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
将左脚放回地面。
重复左脚踩上平台的动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

1009.name: 弹力带直腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，将弹力带绕在脚踝上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，铰接臀部，慢慢将上半身降低到地面。
当你降低时，将臀部向后推，并让膝盖稍微弯曲。
将弹力带降低至地面，感受腿筋的拉伸。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将上半身抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1010.name: 弹力带直腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在脚上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝向身体，手臂伸直。
收紧核心并保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
慢慢地以臀部为中心向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将弹力带降低至地面，同时保持双腿伸直。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1011.name: 弹力带坐姿扭转
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，背部挺直。
将带子绕在腰上，并用双手握住两端。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将躯干扭向一侧，保持背部挺直，双脚着地。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1012.name: 弹力带扭转过头推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
将弹力带手柄保持在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
启动你的核心并将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
当你按压时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，保持臀部稳定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复按压和扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1013.name: 弹力带反握下拉
instructions: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧背阔肌，将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1014.name: 弹力带V字起身
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1015.name: 弹力带垂直帕洛夫推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带缠绕在胸部高度的坚固物体上。
用双手握住弹力带并远离锚点，在弹力带中产生张力。
使自己垂直于锚点，一侧面向弹力带。
将双臂伸直在身前，保持双手与胸同高。
收紧核心肌群，将弹力带压离胸部，充分伸展手臂。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢将弹力带拉回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1016.name: 弹力带腕弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝上，前臂放在大腿上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1017.name: 弹力带Y字上举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝内。
保持双臂伸直，将其向上举至两侧，与身体形成“Y”形。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1018.name: 弹力带耸肩
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下，用手握住两端。
保持手臂伸直并放松，让弹力带悬挂在大腿前面。
向上耸肩，尽可能高地举起弹力带，以启动斜方肌。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1019.name: 弹力带侧弯
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand.
Keep your chest up and your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the band hand.
Return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1020.name: 弹力带侧向卷腹
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

1021.name: 弹力带站姿抬腿
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

1022.name: 弹力带站姿后三角肌划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将弹力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1023.name: 弹力带直背直腿硬拉
1023.englishName: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在大腿上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲，铰接臀部并将弹力带降低到地面。
当你降低弹力带时，感受腿筋的拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1027.name: 辅助单腿腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1028.name: 辅助站姿三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

1029.name: 杠杆平行推胸
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

1030.name: 杠杆蝴蝶机夹胸
instructions: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

1031.name: 杠杆站姿髋伸展
instructions: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1032.name: 杠杆交替二头弯举
instructions: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

1033.name: 杠杆三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

1034.name: 杠杆侧向髋外展
instructions: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1035.name: 杠杆侧向髋内收
instructions: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1036.name: 杠杆站姿抬腿
instructions: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1037.name: 杠杆站姿后踢
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1038.name: 杠杆椅式深蹲
instructions: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

1039.name: 杠杆全蹲
instructions: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

1040.name: 杠杆手枪式深蹲
instructions: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1041.name: 杠杆仰卧推胸(挂片式)
instructions: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

1042.name: 负重仰卧颈伸展
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

1043.name: 负重仰卧颈屈曲
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

1044.name: 杠铃片捏握
instructions: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

1045.name: 杠铃坐姿军事推举(深蹲架内)
1045.englishName: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
instructions: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

1046.name: 绳索抬高划船
instructions: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

1047.name: 绳索窄握前高位下拉
1047.englishName: cable close grip front lat pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

1048.name: 哑铃俯卧单臂后侧平举 v. 2
1048.englishName: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1049.name: 单腿后踢(凳子支撑)
instructions: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1050.name: 史密斯机提踵(垫块)
instructions: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

1051.name: 猫式拉伸
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

1052.name: 固定杆背部拉伸
instructions: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

1053.name: 跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

1054.name: 弓步直腿小腿拉伸
instructions: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1055.name: 俯卧腹部拉伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

1056.name: 仰卧臀部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1057.name: 坐姿腹股沟拉伸
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

1058.name: 站姿单臂胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

1059.name: 站姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

1060.name: 杠铃臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

1061.name: 杠铃单腿臀推
instructions: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1062.name: 负重单腿臀推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

1063.name: 杠铃相扑深蹲
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

1064.name: 相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

1065.name: 仰卧抬髋(稳定球)
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

1066.name: 龙门架站姿胸推
instructions: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

1067.name: 绳索直臂下拉 v. 3
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

1068.name: 绳索后踢 v. 3
instructions: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

1069.name: 绳索转体 v. 3
instructions: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

1070.name: 悬挂带手臂弯举
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

1071.name: 悬挂带屈膝反向划船
instructions: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

1072.name: 悬挂带胸部臂屈伸
instructions: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

1073.name: 悬挂带推胸
instructions: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

1074.name: 悬挂带飞鸟
instructions: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

1075.name: 悬挂带前平举
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

1076.name: 悬挂带腘绳肌跑者式
instructions: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

1077.name: 悬挂带髋外展
instructions: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1078.name: 悬挂带髋桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

1079.name: 悬挂带背部伸展
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

1080.name: 悬挂带反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

1081.name: 悬挂带折刀屈髋
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

1082.name: 悬挂带折刀
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

1083.name: 悬挂带腿弯举
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

1084.name: 悬挂带登山者
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

1085.name: 悬挂训练带屈体
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.

1086.name: 悬挂带爆发拉
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

1087.name: 悬挂带穿腿拉
instructions: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

1088.name: 悬挂带引体向上
instructions: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

1089.name: 悬挂带后三角肌划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

1090.name: 悬挂带反向飞鸟
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

1091.name: 悬挂带前推
instructions: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

1092.name: 悬挂带划船
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

1093.name: 悬挂带自助胸部臂屈伸
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

1094.name: 悬挂带自助引体向上
instructions: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

1095.name: 悬挂带自助三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

1096.name: 悬挂带肩外旋
instructions: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

1097.name: 悬挂带侧弯
instructions: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

1098.name: 悬挂带侧桥
instructions: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

1099.name: 悬挂带单腿分腿蹲(自助)
1099.englishName: suspension single leg split squat (self assisted)
instructions: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

1100.name: 悬挂带单腿分腿蹲
instructions: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

1101.name: 悬挂带单腿深蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

1102.name: 悬挂带直髋腿弯举
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

1103.name: 悬挂带三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

1104.name: 悬挂带三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

1105.name: 悬挂带转体
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

1106.name: 悬挂带扭转折刀
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

1107.name: 悬挂带Y字侧平举
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

1108.name: 悬挂带手臂弯举至耳旁
instructions: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

1109.name: 悬挂带二头肌卡握
instructions: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

1110.name: 悬挂带人体锯
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

1111.name: 悬挂带窄握推胸
instructions: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

1112.name: 悬挂带卷腹
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

1113.name: 悬挂带面拉
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

1114.name: 悬挂训练带前平板支撑
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

1115.name: 悬挂带倒立俯卧撑
instructions: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

1116.name: 悬挂带上斜俯卧撑
instructions: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

1117.name: 悬挂带跳跃深蹲
instructions: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

1118.name: 悬挂训练带背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to standing.

1119.name: 悬挂带后撤交叉弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1120.name: 悬挂带中位划船
instructions: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

1121.name: 悬挂带登山者俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

1122.name: 悬挂带斜向前推
instructions: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

1123.name: 悬挂带单臂二头弯举
instructions: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

1124.name: 悬挂带单臂推胸
instructions: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

1125.name: 悬挂带单臂单腿俯卧撑
1125.englishName: suspender one arm leg push up
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

1126.name: 悬挂带单腿推胸
instructions: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

1127.name: 悬挂带引体向上 v. 2
instructions: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

1128.name: 悬挂带俯卧撑
instructions: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

1129.name: 悬挂带后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

1130.name: 悬挂带反向飞鸟唤醒
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

1131.name: 悬挂带侧向交叉弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

1132.name: 悬挂带侧弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

1133.name: 悬挂带单臂后三角肌划船
1133.englishName: suspender single arm rear delt row
instructions: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1134.name: 悬挂带单腿平板支撑(直臂)
1134.englishName: suspender single leg plank straight arm
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

1135.name: 悬挂带单腿平板支撑
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

1136.name: 悬挂带单腿深蹲(8字)
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1137.name: 悬挂带仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

1138.name: 悬挂带蜘蛛侠俯卧撑
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

1139.name: 悬挂带分腿飞鸟
instructions: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

1140.name: 悬挂带短跑者
instructions: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

1141.name: 悬挂带深蹲(手臂上举)
instructions: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

1142.name: 悬挂训练带深蹲爆发拉
instructions: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.

1143.name: 悬挂带深蹲
instructions: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

1144.name: 悬吊带站姿腹肌滚轮前推
instructions: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

1145.name: 悬吊带星式平板支撑
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

1146.name: 悬吊带星式俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

1147.name: 悬吊带仰卧卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

1148.name: 悬吊带仰卧平板支撑
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

1149.name: 悬吊带三头肌伸展俯卧撑
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

1150.name: 悬吊带三头肌后踢
instructions: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

1151.name: 悬吊带侧向转体
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

1152.name: 悬吊带向上转体
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

1153.name: 悬吊带上背部拉伸
instructions: Hold the handles and step back so your arms are straight.
Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.
Feel the stretch between the shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and return.

1154.name: 悬吊带提踵
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

1155.name: 悬吊带单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1156.name: 悬吊带钟摆
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

1157.name: 悬吊带髋铰链
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

1158.name: 悬吊带侧向拉伸
instructions: Hold the handles and step your legs wide.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Sit back into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

1159.name: 悬吊带外展弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

1160.name: 波比
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将双手放在身前的地板上，将身体降低至蹲姿。
将脚踢回到俯卧撑位置。
进行俯卧撑，保持身体呈一条直线。
将双脚跳回蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

1161.name: 划船(划船机)
instructions: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

1162.name: 杠铃站姿军事推举
instructions: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

1163.name: 仰卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

1164.name: 史密斯机提踵 v. 2
instructions: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

1165.name: 杠铃站姿军事推举(无架)
instructions: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

1166.name: 分腿跳
instructions: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

1167.name: 动态胸部拉伸(男)
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢地将双臂向前伸，交叉在身体前面。
感受胸部肌肉的伸展。
保持拉伸 10-30 秒。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

1168.name: 俯卧腹部拉伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

1169.name: 坐姿腹股沟拉伸
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

1170.name: 45度单腿山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)
1170.englishName: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

1171.name: 45度扭转山羊挺身
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

1172.name: 辅助负重俯卧撑
instructions: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

1173.name: 杠铃上斜宽反握卧推
1173.englishName: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

1174.name: 钻石俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

1175.name: 哑铃前倾弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

1176.name: 哑铃上斜前平举
instructions: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

1177.name: 哑铃仰卧锤式推举 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

1178.name: 哑铃站姿单腿提踵
1178.englishName: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

1179.name: 交替打腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

1180.name: 仰卧同时交替直腿抬腿
1180.englishName: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

1181.name: 仰卧直腿抬腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

1182.name: 俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

1183.name: 史密斯机跪姿后踢
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1184.name: 负重反向划船
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

1185.name: 45度自行车扭转卷腹
instructions: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

1186.name: 交替直腿抬腿(波速球)
1186.englishName: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
instructions: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

1187.name: 壶铃仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

1188.name: 负重扭转卷腹(凳上)
instructions: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

1189.name: 负重V字卷腹(波速球)
instructions: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

1190.name: 上斜扭转仰卧起坐 v. 2
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

1191.name: 三头肌推举(头低于凳)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

1193.name: 铁十字平板支撑
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

1194.name: 杠杆仰卧T杠划船
instructions: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

1195.name: 杠杆上斜锤式胸推
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

1196.name: 哑铃交替二头弯举 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

1197.name: 深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

1198.name: 跳跃引体向上
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

1199.name: 相扑硬拉高拉
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

1200.name: 借力推举
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

1201.name: 哑铃波比
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各拿一个哑铃。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将哑铃放在您面前的地面上。
将双脚踢回到俯卧撑位置，保持身体呈一条直线。
进行俯卧撑，弯曲肘部并将胸部降低到地面。
将脚向后跳向双手，以蹲姿着地。
爆发性地站起来，将哑铃从地上举起，放到肩膀上。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回到肩膀上，然后重复整个序列，达到所需的重复次数。

1202.name: 绳索水平帕洛夫推
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

1203.name: 绳索单臂内侧二头弯举
1203.englishName: cable one arm inner biceps curl
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1204.name: 绳索单臂高位下拉
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

1205.name: 绳索单臂扭转坐姿划船
1205.englishName: cable one arm twisting seated row
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

1206.name: 绳索穿腿拉
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

1207.name: 绳索转体(由下向上)
instructions: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1208.name: 绳索转体(由上向下) v. 2
instructions: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1209.name: 绳索扭转过头推举
instructions: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1210.name: 绳索扭转站姿高位划船
instructions: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

1211.name: 绳索扭转站姿单臂胸推
1211.englishName: cable twisting standing one arm chest press
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

1212.name: 绳索扭转站姿划船
instructions: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

1213.name: 绳索垂直帕洛夫推
instructions: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

1214.name: 哑铃上斜30度反握卧推
1214.englishName: dumbbell incline reverse grip 30 degrees bench press
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

1215.name: 哑铃侧弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

1216.name: 杠杆坐姿单腿提踵
1216.englishName: lever seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.

1220.name: 杠杆提踵(卧推机)
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.

1221.name: 杠杆耸肩(卧推机)
instructions: Set the machine so the handles are at your sides and grip them firmly.
Stand or sit tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly without rolling them.

1222.name: 辅助窄距反握引体向上
1222.englishName: assisted close grip underhand chin up
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

1223.name: 反握反向背部划船
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

1224.name: 史密斯机站姿肩部推举
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and stand under it with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar and hold it at your collarbone.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders slowly.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

1225.name: 站姿杠铃片推举
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your elbows slightly forward.
Press the plate overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching.

1226.name: EZ杠铃站姿过头推举
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar at your upper chest with a comfortable grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest.
Keep your head neutral and avoid leaning back.

1227.name: 绳索站姿单臂三头肌下压(正握)
1227.englishName: cable standing one arm triceps pushdown (overhand grip)
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with an overhand grip and tuck your elbow to your side.
Push down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let the handle rise slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1228.name: 哑铃站姿内侧二头弯举
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, elbows slightly out from your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower them slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

1229.name: 绳索站姿背阔肌下压(绳索把手)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.

1230.name: 哑铃站姿交替垂直前平举
1230.englishName: dumbbell standing alternate vertical front raises
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing in.
Raise one dumbbell straight up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your body.

1231.name: 哑铃坐姿单臂肩部推举
1231.englishName: dumbbell seated one arm shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1232.name: 杠杆坐姿深蹲
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Push through your feet to extend your legs.
Lower slowly until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

1233.name: 哑铃上斜交替锤式弯举
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

1234.name: 杠铃片山羊挺身
instructions: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.

1235.name: 杠杆单臂坐姿划船(坐姿划船机)
1235.englishName: lever one arm seated row (seated row machine)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1236.name: 哑铃单臂划船(架子支撑)
instructions: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1237.name: 杠杆划船(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

1238.name: 绳索坐姿划船(弯杆)
instructions: Sit at a low cable station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the bent bar with both hands.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly without rounding forward.

1241.name: 鸟狗式
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

1242.name: 卷腹(波速球)
instructions: Sit on the bosu ball and lie back so it supports your lower back.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up by contracting your abs.
Hold the top briefly.
Lower slowly and keep your feet planted.

1243.name: 死虫式 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

1244.name: 交替打腿 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.

1245.name: 仰卧抬腿并保持
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.

1246.name: 空心支撑
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

1247.name: 俄罗斯转体(药球)
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball by your hip.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and move with control.

1248.name: 半雨刷式(屈腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides for support.
Lift your knees to 90 degrees.
Lower both knees to one side, stopping before the floor.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.

1249.name: 雨刷式(直腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Raise your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side with control.
Lift them back to the middle and lower to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.

1250.name: 负重卷腹(手置脑后)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight behind your head with your elbows out.
Curl your shoulders up, contracting your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

1253.name: 杠杆驴式提踵
instructions: 将杠杆机调节至适合您身体的高度。
面向机器定位，脚趾放在脚踏平台上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
将手放在手柄或支撑杆上以保持稳定性。
用脚掌收紧小腿并尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1254.name: 弹力带卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住带子手柄，间距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将弹力带推离胸部。
慢慢将弹力带放回到胸部，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
重复所需的重复次数。

1255.name: 杠铃下斜仰卧上拉
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部，双脚固定。
旋前握住杠铃（手掌背向自己），双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将手臂伸至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，感受胸部和肩膀的伸展。
暂停片刻，然后反向动作将杠铃恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1256.name: 杠铃反握下斜卧推
1256.englishName: barbell reverse grip decline bench press
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
反握抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1257.name: 杠铃反握上斜卧推
1257.englishName: barbell reverse grip incline bench press
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反握抓住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1258.name: 杠铃宽反握卧推
1258.englishName: barbell wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握宽握杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部内收，手腕伸直。
当杠铃接触胸部时暂停片刻，然后将其推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1259.name: 头后胸部拉伸
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将手指交叉放在脑后，肘部朝外。
慢慢地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，并将胸部向前推。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
松开拉伸并根据需要重复。

1260.name: 绳索下斜单臂推举
instructions: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
背对机器站立，用一只手抓住手柄。
将背部靠在下斜长凳上，手臂伸直在身前。
弯曲肘部，将手柄向胸部方向降低，同时保持上臂静止。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1261.name: 绳索下斜推举
instructions: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
坐在面向缆绳机的下降长凳上。
正手握住手柄并将其置于胸部水平。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部牢牢靠在长凳上。
呼气并将手柄推离身体，充分伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，挤压胸部肌肉。
吸气并慢慢地将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1262.name: 绳索单臂下斜飞鸟
1262.englishName: cable one arm decline chest fly
instructions: 将 D 形手柄连接到低滑轮绳索机器上，并将长凳设置为下降角度。
躺在长凳上，头朝向机器，用右手抓住手柄。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
控制动作，将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作并将手臂恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后切换到左臂并重复练习。

1263.name: 绳索单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
1263.englishName: cable one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂向一侧伸出，与地面平行。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢地将手臂放在身体上，挤压胸部肌肉。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1264.name: 绳索单臂上斜飞鸟(稳定球)
1264.englishName: cable one arm incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，慢慢地将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1265.name: 绳索单臂上斜推举
instructions: 将拉索机调整至低滑轮位置。
坐在倾斜的长凳上，背对缆绳机。
用一只手抓住手柄并将其举至肩膀高度。
将双脚牢牢放在地面上并保持稳定的位置。
向前和向上按下手柄，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1266.name: 绳索单臂上斜推举(稳定球)
1266.englishName: cable one arm incline press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂呈 90 度角，肘部弯曲。
向前和向上按下电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1267.name: 绳索单臂推举(稳定球)
1267.englishName: cable one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂置于胸部高度，肘部弯曲。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向前按电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1268.name: 绳索推举(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖呈 90 度角。
将电缆手柄保持在胸部高度，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲。
收紧核心并向前按压缆索手柄，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，并将电缆手柄拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1269.name: 绳索站姿直立夹胸
instructions: 站在缆绳机中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
手掌朝下握住电缆手柄，手臂伸直至两侧。
保持双臂伸直，将双手放在身体前面，相互交叉。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，保持双臂伸展。
重复所需的重复次数。

1270.name: 绳索上胸夹胸
instructions: 将手柄连接到胸部高度的电缆上。
站在绳索机的中央，一只脚稍微在另一只脚前面。
手掌朝下抓住手柄，手臂向两侧伸展。
保持肘部轻微弯曲并启动核心肌群。
将电缆在胸前拉到一起，使它们相互交叉。
在运动的最高点挤压胸部肌肉。
慢慢地将电缆释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1271.name: 胸部及前肩拉伸
1271.englishName: chest and front of shoulder stretch
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉并将手掌压在一起。
轻轻地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，然后将双手向前推，感觉胸部和肩膀前部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
重复所需的重复次数。

1272.name: 稳定球胸部拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住健身球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将健身球移向胸部，感受胸部肌肉的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1273.name: 击掌俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
爆发性地推动手掌，将身体推离地面。
在半空中时，拍手，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1274.name: 深度俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1275.name: 落地俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，迅速将膝盖放在地上。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1276.name: 哑铃下斜单臂飞鸟
instructions: 躺在斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
用大腿帮助举起哑铃，将其举至与肩同宽，手掌朝向躯干。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
吸气时，将哑铃慢慢降低到一侧，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气并使用胸部肌肉将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1277.name: 哑铃飞鸟(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将双臂伸直至胸部上方，手掌相对。
稍微弯曲肘部，将手臂以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反向运动并挤压胸部肌肉，同时将​​哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1278.name: 哑铃上斜飞鸟(稳定球)
1278.englishName: dumbbell incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸至胸部上方。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1279.name: 哑铃上斜单臂飞鸟
instructions: 将倾斜凳调整至 30-45 度角。
坐在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
向后躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1280.name: 哑铃上斜单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
1280.englishName: dumbbell incline one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1281.name: 哑铃上斜单臂推举
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃置于与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1282.name: 哑铃上斜单臂推举(稳定球)
1282.englishName: dumbbell incline one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，滚动球，直到你的头、脖子和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃握在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1283.name: 哑铃上斜推举(稳定球)
1283.englishName: dumbbell incline press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
双脚慢慢向前移动，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1284.name: 哑铃仰卧上拉(稳定球)
1284.englishName: dumbbell lying pullover on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在球上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1285.name: 哑铃单臂卧姿飞鸟
instructions: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上方。
向后躺在长凳上，将哑铃压在大腿上。
用空着的那只手帮助将哑铃举至起始位置。
将哑铃握在肩膀正上方，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动并将哑铃带回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。

1286.name: 哑铃单臂胸部飞鸟(稳定球)
1286.englishName: dumbbell one arm chest fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，滚动球，直到你的上背部受到球的支撑，并且你的头、脖子和肩膀离开球。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1287.name: 哑铃单臂下斜胸推
1287.englishName: dumbbell one arm decline chest press
instructions: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部压在长凳上。
伸展手臂，将哑铃推向天花板，充分伸展肘部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1288.name: 哑铃单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
1288.englishName: dumbbell one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到上背部靠在健身球上。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1289.name: 哑铃单臂上斜胸推
1289.englishName: dumbbell one arm incline chest press
instructions: 将上斜凳调整至 45 度角。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，正手握住，将其放在肩膀上。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1290.name: 哑铃单臂推举(稳定球)
1290.englishName: dumbbell one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
一只手握住哑铃，将其置于与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，同时保持核心收紧并在健身球上保持平衡。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1291.name: 哑铃单臂上拉(稳定球)
1291.englishName: dumbbell one arm pullover on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
用一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1292.name: 哑铃单腿飞鸟(稳定球)
1292.englishName: dumbbell one leg fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将一只脚放在地面上，并将另一条腿伸直到您面前。
稍微向前倾，将手臂向两侧伸出，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃向两侧放低，感觉胸部有拉伸感。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1293.name: 哑铃推举(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动双脚，滚动健身球，直到下背部受到球的支撑并且膝盖呈 90 度角。
将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1294.name: 哑铃上拉伸髋(稳定球)
1294.englishName: dumbbell pullover hip extension on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，哑铃放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，将健身球沿着你的背部滚动，直到你的头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将哑铃放在脑后，保持手臂伸直并保持控制。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
在保持双臂伸展的同时，将臀部抬离地面，挤压臀肌并启动核心肌群。
将臀部放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1295.name: 哑铃上拉(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双手握住哑铃，置于胸前，双臂伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1296.name: 稳定球屈体俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手放在地板上，小腿放在稳定球上。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，将球滚向双手。
保持双腿伸直，身体呈屈体姿势，形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，将上半身降低到地板上，保持头部与双手在一条直线上。
用手推动并伸展双臂以返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1297.name: 等长夹胸
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行，手掌相对。
尽可能用力挤压胸部肌肉，同时保持手臂伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩胸部肌肉。
释放挤压并放松胸部肌肉。
重复所需的重复次数。

1298.name: 壶铃单臂地板推举
instructions: 仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住壶铃，手掌朝向脚部，手臂笔直向上伸向天花板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将壶铃降低到胸部，保持上臂靠近身体。
当壶铃位于胸部正上方时暂停片刻，然后通过伸展肘部将壶铃推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1299.name: 杠杆上斜胸推
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部，将手柄放回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。

1300.name: 杠杆下斜胸推
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将手柄放回胸部，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1301.name: 器械内侧胸推
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，背部平放在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，运动过程中呼气。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时吸气。
重复所需的重复次数。

1302.name: 药球胸前传球
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，用力将药球推离胸部。
当你释放球时，用你的手臂和躯干将球从后脚转移到前脚。
当球从墙壁或伙伴身上反弹时接住球，并立即重复该动作。
继续进行所需的重复次数。

1303.name: 药球三点支撑胸推
1303.englishName: medicine ball chest push from 3 point stance
instructions: 以三点姿势开始，一只手放在健身球上，另一只手放在地上。
伸展双腿并将身体摆成一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，同时保持背部挺直。
将药球推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

1304.name: 药球连续胸推
1304.englishName: medicine ball chest push multiple response
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。

1305.name: 药球单次胸推
1305.englishName: medicine ball chest push single response
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。

1306.name: 增强式俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
爆发性地推离地面，利用胸部肌肉将上半身推离地面。
双手回到起始位置，轻轻落地。
重复所需的重复次数。

1307.name: 波速球俯卧撑
instructions: 将博苏球平放在地上，平面朝上。
将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在博苏球的外边缘。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体向博苏球方向降低。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1308.name: 史密斯机宽握卧推
instructions: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整到舒适的位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部向两侧伸出。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1309.name: 史密斯机宽握下斜卧推
1309.englishName: smith wide grip decline bench press
instructions: 将下斜凳调整至所需角度。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部朝外。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1310.name: 负重落地俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，爆发性地把自己推起来，将双手抬离地面。
当你向上推时，快速将双手移至两侧并稍微向前，让你的身体向地面落下。
将双手置于更宽的位置，然后立即再次将胸部降低到地面。
重复俯卧撑动作，下降并用双手抓住自己在较窄的位置。
继续在更宽和更窄的手位置之间交替，以达到所需的重复次数。

1311.name: 宽距俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开比肩宽。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1312.name: 药球跑动出手胸推
1312.englishName: medicine ball chest push with run release
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
右脚向前迈出一步，同时向前推动药球，充分伸展双臂。
当你向前推动球时，松开它并让它向前滚动。
快速向前跑，在球落地之前接住球。
接住球后，将其放回胸前，左脚向前重复该动作。
继续交替双腿并重复练习达到所需的重复次数。

1313.name: 杠杆单侧划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住手柄并保持背部挺直。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1314.name: 稳定球背部伸展
instructions: 将稳定球放在地面上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1315.name: 背部放松
instructions: Get into a comfortable resting position, such as kneeling with your torso folded forward.
Rest your arms in a relaxed position.
Let your back round and release.
Breathe slowly into your lower back.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

1316.name: 杠铃屈臂上拉
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
握距与肩同宽，握住杠铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将杠铃放在脑后，同时保持手臂稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1317.name: 杠铃反握上斜凳划船
1317.englishName: barbell reverse grip incline bench row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，面向靠背，胸部靠在靠背上。
反握（手掌朝下）抓住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1318.name: 绳索上斜凳划船
instructions: 以 45 度角设置一个上斜凳，并将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮上。
坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
从臀部开始向前倾，同时保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将电缆手柄拉向胸部。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉，然后慢慢伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1319.name: 绳索旋掌划船
instructions: 将手柄连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
向后退一步，在绳索上产生张力，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将手柄拉向身体，同时将手掌旋转至向上。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1320.name: 绳索绳把交叉坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将缆绳拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1321.name: 绳索绳把抬高坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在面向电缆机的高架座椅上。
正手握住缆绳手柄，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
通过缩回肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将电缆拉向您的身体。
在完全收缩的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢释放压力并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1322.name: 绳索绳把伸展上斜凳划船
1322.englishName: cable rope extension incline bench row
instructions: 以 45 度角设置上斜凳，并将绳索机连接到低滑轮上。
将绳索手柄连接到缆绳机上，然后坐在面向机器的倾斜长凳上。
正手抓住绳索把手，身体前倾，保持背部挺直。
充分伸展双臂，将绳子拉向上胸部，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1323.name: 绳索绳把坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向前倾斜，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将缆绳拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1324.name: 绳索上部划船
instructions: 将直杆连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1325.name: 绳索宽握颈后下拉
1325.englishName: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck
instructions: 调整缆绳机，使下拉杆位于您头部上方的高度。
坐在座椅上，用宽的正手握法抓住下拉杆。
稍微向后倾斜时，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1326.name: 反握引体向上
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1327.name: 窄握反握引体向上
instructions: 抓住引体向上杆，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1328.name: 哑铃俯卧后三角肌划船
instructions: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直向下伸向地板，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
调动背部肌肉，将哑铃举向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1329.name: 哑铃旋掌俯身划船
1329.englishName: dumbbell palm rotational bent over row
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
让你的手臂笔直下垂，手掌朝向身体。
收紧核心肌群，将哑铃拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你向上拉哑铃时，旋转手掌，使其背向身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，将手掌旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1330.name: 哑铃反握上斜凳单臂划船
1330.englishName: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将哑铃放在长凳旁边的地板上。
面对长凳站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲腰部，将左膝和左手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
用右手反握（手掌朝下）拿起哑铃。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉。
以受控的方式将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用左臂重复练习。

1331.name: 哑铃反握上斜凳双臂划船
1331.englishName: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，胸部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，反握。
