instructions: 面朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌面向身体，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1667.name: 哑铃单臂反握蜘蛛弯举
1667.englishName: dumbbell one arm reverse spider curl
instructions: 站直，一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝下，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，将哑铃向肩膀方向卷曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1668.name: 哑铃单臂坐姿二头弯举(稳定球)
1668.englishName: dumbbell one arm seated bicep curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1669.name: 哑铃单臂坐姿锤式弯举
1669.englishName: dumbbell one arm seated hammer curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，保持中立握姿（手掌相对）。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1670.name: 哑铃单臂站姿弯举
instructions: 站直，一手握哑铃，手掌朝前，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并向上弯曲重量，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1671.name: 哑铃单臂站姿锤式弯举
1671.englishName: dumbbell one arm standing hammer curl
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1672.name: 哑铃单臂佐特曼牧师凳弯举
1672.englishName: dumbbell one arm zottman preacher curl
instructions: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，单手握哑铃，反握。
将上臂放在牧师凳垫上，让手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在卷曲的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝上。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1673.name: 哑铃牧师凳弯举(稳定球上)
1673.englishName: dumbbell preacher curl over exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反握，将肘部放在健身球上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1674.name: 哑铃俯卧上斜锤式弯举
instructions: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
让你的手臂垂直垂向地板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1675.name: 哑铃反握蜘蛛弯举
instructions: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1676.name: 哑铃坐姿交替锤式弯举(稳定球)
1676.englishName: dumbbell seated alternate hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持手掌朝向身体。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1677.name: 哑铃坐姿二头弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1678.name: 哑铃坐姿锤式弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂伸直向下。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1679.name: 哑铃单臂坐姿二头弯举(稳定球,单腿抬起)
1679.englishName: dumbbell seated one arm bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。

1680.name: 哑铃站姿单臂弯举(上斜凳上方)
1680.englishName: dumbbell standing one arm curl over incline bench
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将另一只手放在倾斜的长凳上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1681.name: 哑铃双臂坐姿锤式弯举(稳定球)
1681.englishName: dumbbell two arm seated hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Plant your feet wide for balance and keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full arm extension.
Keep your chest tall and avoid swinging your torso.

1682.name: EZ杠坐姿窄握集中弯举
1682.englishName: ez bar seated close grip concentration curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住 EZ 杠铃。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1683.name: 史密斯机二头弯举
instructions: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整到腰部水平。
面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手间距略大于肩宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1684.name: 哑铃上台阶单腿平衡加二头弯举
1684.englishName: dumbbell step up single leg balance with bicep curl
instructions: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
启动核心并推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点，弯曲肘部并将哑铃拉向肩膀，进行二头肌弯举。
将哑铃放回原处，同时将左脚放回地面。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向上并弯举哑铃。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1685.name: 深蹲至过头伸展
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂伸过头顶，伸向天花板。
放下手臂并弯曲膝盖再次蹲下，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1686.name: 深蹲至过头伸展并转体
1686.englishName: squat to overhead reach with twist
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂举过头顶并将躯干扭转到一侧。
返回起始位置并重复下蹲，这次将躯干扭转到另一侧。
每次深蹲重复时继续交替进行。

1687.name: 后撤上步至过头伸展
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双臂放在身体两侧。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲左膝并将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你降低弓步时，同时将手臂举过头顶。
在弓步底部暂停片刻，然后通过推动左脚跟并将右脚向前拉回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向后退一步并弯曲右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1688.name: 弓步蹲加转体
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你弓步时，将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的左肘拉向你的右膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向前迈出，并将躯干向左扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1689.name: 徒手推拉
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从俯卧撑位置开始，弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1692.name: 矢状面弓步蹲加药球过头推举
1692.englishName: sagittal plane lunge with overhead medicine ball press
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height and stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press the ball overhead as you rise.
Lower the ball and step back to the start.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.

1693.name: 药球单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest and stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the ball toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

1694.name: 哑铃过头侧弓步蹲
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands or one hand and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit back into the hips.
Keep your chest tall and your arm locked out overhead.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.

1695.name: 稳定球单腿深蹲
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Lift one foot and balance on the other leg.
Lower into a squat while the ball rolls down the wall.
Press through your heel to stand back up.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1696.name: 横断面哑铃弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Step diagonally back or across your body into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent, keeping your chest upright.
Push through the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.

1697.name: 药球反向劈柴深蹲
1697.englishName: medicine ball reverse wood chop squat
instructions: Hold a medicine ball overhead to one side and stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down while chopping the ball diagonally across your body.
Rotate your torso and bring the ball toward the opposite knee.
Stand up as you return the ball overhead.
Alternate sides each set.

1698.name: 向前单脚跳
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent.
Swing your arms and hop forward a short distance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Reset your posture and hop again.
Keep your hops controlled and your chest tall.

1699.name: 药球旋转抛球
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Rotate away from the wall and load your back hip.
Explosively rotate and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it on the rebound and repeat.
Switch sides after the planned reps.

1700.name: 哑铃借力推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖，身体下沉，然后爆发性伸展双腿，将哑铃压过头顶。
在动作的最高点锁定手臂，然后将哑铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

1701.name: 药球窄距俯卧撑
1701.englishName: medicine ball close grip push up
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手放在健身球上，距离与肩同宽。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1702.name: 单腿触脚
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach down toward your foot or the floor.
Keep your back flat and your free leg extended behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

1703.name: 单腿横向屈体
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach across your body.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach.
Return to standing with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1704.name: 药球单腿劈柴
1704.englishName: medicine ball single leg wood chop
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a medicine ball overhead to one side.
Chop the ball diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and pivot your standing foot.
Return the ball overhead with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

1705.name: 波速球深蹲
instructions: 将博苏球平放在地上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将自己放在博苏球的顶部。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1706.name: 稳定球前平板支撑
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral and your hips from sagging or rising.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower to the floor.

1707.name: 稳定球俯卧转体
instructions: 首先，面朝下躺在稳定球上，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾接触地面。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动核心肌肉，慢慢将上半身抬离球，保持背部挺直。
将躯干旋转到一侧，使肩膀靠近臀部。在整个运动过程中保持臀部和腿部稳定。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复旋转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1708.name: 辅助仰卧小腿拉伸
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将脚平放在地上。
用手或毛巾轻轻地将脚趾拉向身体，感受小腿的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一条腿上重复。

1709.name: 辅助仰卧臀部拉伸
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。

1710.name: 辅助仰卧臀肌与梨状肌拉伸
1710.englishName: assisted lying gluteus and piriformis stretch
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一侧重复。

1711.name: 辅助斜向臀小肌与臀中肌拉伸
1711.englishName: assisted oblique glute minimus and medius stretch
instructions: Lie on your back or side while your partner supports your top leg.
Have your partner gently guide the leg across your body while you stay relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1712.name: 辅助侧卧内收肌拉伸
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
稍微弯曲下面的腿以保持稳定。
将上脚放在稳定的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上。
保持上腿伸直，慢慢将其降低到地面，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。

1713.name: 辅助俯卧股四头肌拉伸
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲左膝，用左手向后抓住左脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将左脚拉向臀肌，感受左股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
右腿重复上述动作。

1714.name: 辅助俯卧股直肌拉伸
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲右膝，用右手向后伸抓住右脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将右脚或脚踝拉向臀部，感受右大腿前部的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。

1715.name: 辅助腹斜肌与背阔肌拉伸(稳定球)
1715.englishName: assisted oblique and latissimus dorsi stretch on stability ball
instructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball with your hips supported and one arm reaching overhead.
Let your partner gently guide your reaching arm further while you roll slightly over the ball.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1716.name: 辅助坐姿胸大肌拉伸(稳定球)
1716.englishName: assisted seated pectoralis major stretch with stability ball
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住稳定球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将稳定球降低到胸部，感受胸肌的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1717.name: 绳索深蹲划船(绳索把手)
instructions: 将绳子连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住绳子，双手与肩同宽。
收紧核心并将绳子拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持肘部靠近身体并继续拉，直到双手到达胸部。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳子，并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1718.name: 杠铃坐姿窄握颈后三头肌伸展
1718.englishName: barbell seated close grip behind neck triceps extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧抓住颈后的杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近头部，慢慢将杠铃放低至脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1719.name: 杠铃上斜窄握卧推
1719.englishName: barbell incline close grip bench press
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1720.name: 杠铃仰卧脑后三头肌伸展
1720.englishName: barbell lying back of the head tricep extension
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1721.name: 杠铃反握仰卧臂屈伸
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
反握握住杠铃，手掌朝向脸部，双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部内收和手腕伸直。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1722.name: 绳索高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
1722.englishName: cable high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，背对机器站立。
双手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸过头顶。
保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1723.name: 绳索单臂三头肌下压
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，并在胸部高度处安装直杆附件。
正手握住杠铃，然后后退以在绳索上产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
首先，手臂完全伸展并垂直于地板。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向下推，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1724.name: 绳索绳把高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
1724.englishName: cable rope high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上并相应地调整重量。
背对滑轮机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳子，掌心朝下，双手举过头顶。
保持上臂靠近头部并垂直于地板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1725.name: 绳索绳把上斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，并将倾斜长凳调整到舒适的角度。
背对滑轮站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸直过头顶。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，直到前臂接触二头肌，将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1726.name: 绳索绳把地面仰卧三头肌伸展
1726.englishName: cable rope lying on floor tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到缆绳机上并将其设置到最低位置。
面朝上躺在地板上，头朝向电缆机。
双手握住绳子，掌心相对，双臂伸直向上伸向天花板。
保持上臂静止，慢慢地将绳子放低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1727.name: 绳索站姿反握单臂过头三头肌伸展
1727.englishName: cable standing reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: 背对缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近头部。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将电缆手柄降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1728.name: 绳索双臂三头肌后踢
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，向后伸展前臂，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1729.name: 哑铃仰卧交替伸展
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将一个哑铃朝头部方向放下，肘部弯曲，同时保持另一只手臂伸展。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

1730.name: 哑铃坐姿俯身交替后踢
1730.englishName: dumbbell seated bent over alternate kickback
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将一只手臂向后伸直，保持靠近身体，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1731.name: 哑铃窄握推举
instructions: 坐在平坦的长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
用你的大腿帮助举起哑铃，一次举起一个哑铃，这样你就可以将它们保持在与肩同宽的位置。
一旦与肩同宽，向前旋转手腕，使手掌背向自己。这将是您的起始位置。
当你吸气时，慢慢地将哑铃降低到你的身边，直到它们与你的胸部齐平。
呼气时，用三头肌将哑铃举回到起始位置。确保只使用三头肌，不要使用前臂或二头肌来帮助举起哑铃。
在收缩位置第二次暂停后，重复该动作达到规定的重复次数。

1732.name: 哑铃前弓步蹲三头肌伸展
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手臂伸直过头顶，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂回到起始位置。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1733.name: 哑铃上斜双臂伸展
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地躺在长凳上，保持哑铃靠近胸部。
完全躺下后，将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1734.name: 哑铃后踢(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1735.name: 哑铃仰卧单臂伸展
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂完全伸展到胸部上方。
以受控的方式将哑铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部短暂暂停，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1736.name: 哑铃单臂法式推举(稳定球)
1736.englishName: dumbbell one arm french press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部不动。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1737.name: 哑铃坐姿俯身三头肌伸展
1737.englishName: dumbbell seated bent over triceps extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部抬起。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近头部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1738.name: 哑铃坐姿反握单臂过头三头肌伸展
1738.englishName: dumbbell seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1739.name: 哑铃站姿交替三头肌后踢
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，每次重复时交替进行。

1740.name: 哑铃站姿俯身单臂三头肌伸展
1740.englishName: dumbbell standing bent over one arm triceps extension
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1741.name: 哑铃站姿俯身双臂三头肌伸展
1741.englishName: dumbbell standing bent over two arm triceps extension
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1742.name: 哑铃三头肌后踢(鹤立式站姿)
1742.englishName: dumbbell tricep kickback with stork stance
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将右肘举至身体一侧，保持弯曲 90 度角。
将右臂向后伸直，挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1743.name: 哑铃扭转卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌背向自己。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
放下哑铃时，扭转手腕，使手掌在动作底部面向自己。
在底部暂停片刻，然后通过将哑铃推回到起始位置来反转动作。
当你向上推哑铃时，将手腕扭转回起始位置，手掌背向自己。
重复所需的重复次数。

1744.name: 稳定球臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在臀部旁边的球上，手指指向前方。
启动你的三头肌并用力推动你的身体，将你的身体抬离球，伸直你的手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低，使其靠近身体两侧。
重复所需的重复次数。

1745.name: 稳定球坐姿三头肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶上方。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。

1746.name: 稳定球仰卧三头肌伸展
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直向天花板方向伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1747.name: EZ杠法式推举(稳定球)
1747.englishName: ez bar french press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，正手握住 EZ 杠铃。
向上伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1748.name: EZ杠仰卧窄握脑后三头肌伸展
1748.englishName: ez bar lying close grip triceps extension behind head
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
紧紧握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1749.name: EZ杠站姿法式推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1750.name: 药球仰卧胸前抛
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住药球，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将健身球降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
爆发性地将药球向上推，充分伸展双臂并将球扔得尽可能高。
接住药球并重复所需的重复次数。

1751.name: 杠铃销钉位推举
instructions: 将杠铃放在与胸部同高的力量架上。
面向杠铃站立，将自己置于杠铃下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1752.name: 史密斯机上斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 调整史密斯机的座椅，使杠铃处于肩部高度。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到前额，保持肘部靠近头部。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1753.name: 三凳臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1754.name: 负重三凳臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，并用手臂支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1755.name: 负重三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将你的屁股从长凳前面滑下来，双腿在你面前伸展。
保持背部靠近长凳，肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1756.name: 杠铃单腿硬拉
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，正手握住杠铃在大腿前面。
将重心转移到左脚上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，右腿向后伸展以保持平衡。
将杠铃向地面降低，使其靠近身体，左腿稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1757.name: 哑铃单腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将体重转移到左腿上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
保持背部挺直，臀部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
同时，将右腿伸直在身后，保持左膝轻微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到躯干和右腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后收紧臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1758.name: 辅助仰卧起坐
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘或让某人按住你的脚。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1759.name: 单腿深蹲(手枪式)男
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右脚抬离地面并向前伸展。
弯曲左膝并将臀部向后推，慢慢降低身体。
降低身体时，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低直到左大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

1760.name: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住哑铃垂直放在胸前。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1761.name: 悬垂斜向抬膝
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1762.name: 辅助单腿深蹲(手枪式)
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.

1763.name: 肩宽握引体向上
instructions: 握距与肩同宽，抓住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
双臂完全伸展，自由悬挂。
启动背部肌肉，将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1764.name: 悬垂抬腿抬髋
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，收紧核心并抬起双腿，直到大腿与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1765.name: 哑铃直立划船(背面视角)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展，手掌面向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
继续举起哑铃，直到哑铃与肩同高，肘部指向两侧。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1766.name: 自助反向腿弯举
instructions: 面朝下躺在腿弯举机上，双腿伸展，脚踝钩在带衬垫的杠杆下。
将双手放在机器的侧手柄上以获得支撑。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1767.name: 高双杠负重三头肌臂屈伸
1767.englishName: weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双手握住杠，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1769.name: 徒手侧卧二头弯举
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
将上臂靠在身体两侧，弯曲肘部，将前臂卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1770.name: 腿上集中弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1771.name: 徒手跪姿三头肌伸展
instructions: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1772.name: 抬肘反向俯卧撑
instructions: 首先，脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸展，双手直接放在肩膀下方。
收紧核心并用手掌按压，将上半身抬离地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压上背部肌肉。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1773.name: 毛巾单臂划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
完全伸展手臂，让毛巾挂在您面前。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1774.name: 侧桥髋外展
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持核心肌群参与的同时，尽可能高地抬起上面的那条腿，但不要旋转臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后将腿放下。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1775.name: 侧平板支撑髋内收
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将上面的腿抬向天花板，保持笔直。
慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1776.name: 仰卧单直腿伸髋
1776.englishName: lying single straight leg hip extension
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Tighten your abs and glutes.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.

1777.name: 过头胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1778.name: 辅助站姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1779.name: 辅助坐姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1780.name: 屈臂胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1781.name: 墙角胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1782.name: 反向胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1783.name: 站姿胸部拉伸(用训练肋木)
1783.englishName: standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
instructions: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1784.name: 辅助向后拉背部胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1785.name: 跪姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1786.name: 辅助躯干屈曲胸部拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1787.name: 直臂向后胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1788.name: 过头直臂拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1789.name: 辅助仰卧直臂拉伸(胸部)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1790.name: 辅助俯卧拉臂胸部拉伸
1790.englishName: assisted pulling arms in prone position chest stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1791.name: 斜方肌与颈部拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1792.name: 环绕肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1793.name: 交叉肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1794.name: 向前伸展上背部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1795.name: 伸展上背部拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1796.name: 站姿上举背部旋转拉伸
1796.englishName: standing reach up back rotation stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1797.name: 上举背部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1798.name: 仰卧全身拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1799.name: 双手悬挂背部拉伸(用肋木)
1799.englishName: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
instructions: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1800.name: 绳索悬吊背部拉伸
instructions: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1801.name: 单臂背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1802.name: 侧向背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1803.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1804.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌侧屈肌拉伸
1804.englishName: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1805.name: 坐姿俯身背部拉伸
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1806.name: 坐姿侧伸拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1807.name: 盘腿坐姿前伸拉伸
1807.englishName: sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1808.name: 后倚下躯干伸肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1809.name: 坐姿并脚前伸拉伸
1809.englishName: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1810.name: 仰卧膝碰胸拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1811.name: 站姿膝碰胸拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1812.name: 跪姿背部旋转拉伸
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1813.name: 站姿背部旋转拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1814.name: 肘屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1815.name: 前臂旋前肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1816.name: 手臂垂直伸展拉伸
1816.englishName: extension of arms in vertical stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1817.name: 支撑物上手臂拉伸
instructions: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1818.name: 旋后握杆悬吊拉伸
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1819.name: 滑轮机旋后悬吊拉伸
1819.englishName: suspension in pulley machine in supination stretch
instructions: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1820.name: EZ杠牧师凳手臂拉伸
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1821.name: 肘伸展及前臂旋后旋前拉伸
1821.englishName: elbow extension and supination pronation forearm stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1822.name: 腕尺偏肌和伸肌拉伸
1822.englishName: wrist ulnar deviator and extensor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1823.name: 腕桡偏肌和伸肌拉伸
1823.englishName: wrist radial deviator and extensor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1824.name: 腕桡偏肌和屈肌拉伸
1824.englishName: wrist radial deviator and flexor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1825.name: 腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
1825.englishName: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1826.name: 手指屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1827.name: 手指伸肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1828.name: 向下够取三头肌拉伸
instructions: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1829.name: 靠墙三头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1830.name: 肘伸肌肘肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1831.name: 颈部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1832.name: 颈部斜向屈曲拉伸
instructions: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1833.name: 颈部伸展拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1834.name: 颈部前伸拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

1835.name: 坐姿颈部屈曲拉伸
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

1836.name: 颈部前屈拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.

1837.name: 颈伸肌拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

1838.name: 颈伸肌及旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1839.name: 颈屈肌拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.

1840.name: 颈屈肌及旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1841.name: 仰卧颈伸肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.

1842.name: 仰卧颈部伸展拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

1843.name: 辅助颈部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1844.name: 颈部伸展及侧倾拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1845.name: 下斜屈膝反向卷腹
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

1846.name: 弹力带热身肩部拉伸
instructions: Hold a light band with both hands in front of your thighs, hands wide.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Lift the band overhead and continue back behind your head as far as is comfortable.
Return along the same path to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, widening your grip if it feels tight.

1847.name: 髋部绕圈拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Place your hands on your hips.
Rotate your hips in a wide circle.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Reverse and circle the other way.
Keep your shoulders still and your knees soft.

1848.name: 小腿静态拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1849.name: 腕伸肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1850.name: 腕屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1851.name: 上斜借力推举
instructions: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.

1852.name: 抬腿抬髋
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

1853.name: 抬髋腰部离地
1853.englishName: hip lift low back off floor
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

1854.name: 微屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.

1855.name: 抬腿抬髋抬头
1855.englishName: leg raise hip lift with head up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.

1856.name: 杠杆仰卧抬腿(屈膝)
instructions: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.

1857.name: 杠杆全腹卷腹
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.

1858.name: 杠杆下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower back slowly under control.

1859.name: 绳索跪姿三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.

1860.name: 山羊挺身 v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.

1861.name: 绳索多功能V形杆弯举
1861.englishName: cable curl with multipurpose v bar
instructions: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.

1862.name: 杠杆绳索肩部推举
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

1863.name: 杠杆绳索后下拉
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.

1864.name: 加强下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.

1865.name: 双杠架锤式握引体向上
1865.englishName: hammer grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

1866.name: 双杠架宽握引体向上
1866.englishName: wide grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

1867.name: 杠杆坐姿髋内收 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Squeeze your legs together smoothly.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.

1868.name: 杠铃低杠深蹲(用深蹲架)
instructions: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

1869.name: 杠杆坐姿髋外展 v. 2
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Hold the handles for stability.
Push your legs apart smoothly.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.

1870.name: 杠杆高位下拉(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full stretch.

1871.name: 杠杆三头肌臂屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

1872.name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

1873.name: 杠杆腿屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

1874.name: 杠杆交替腿屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Hold the handles.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.

1875.name: 杠杆深蹲(挂片式)
instructions: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.

1876.name: 杠杆侧平举(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

1877.name: 站姿髋外展内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1878.name: 站姿交叉腿外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1879.name: 站姿抬腿搭放髋部拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1880.name: 倾身外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1881.name: 站姿腿置下方外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1882.name: 仰卧外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1883.name: 健身球仰卧外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1884.name: 仰卧悬腿外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1885.name: 站姿脚尖上翘跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1886.name: 单脚脚跟下落跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1887.name: 站姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1888.name: 站姿跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1889.name: 坐姿拉脚尖跟腱拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1890.name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
instructions: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1891.name: 脚趾深蹲拉伸
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.

1892.name: 跪姿脚跟下压跟腱拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1893.name: 深蹲跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.

1894.name: 站姿宽膝内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.

1895.name: 站姿髋部旋转拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1896.name: 站姿抬腿髋内收肌拉伸
1896.englishName: standing raised leg hip adductor stretch
instructions: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1897.name: 站姿腿上抬内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1898.name: 跪姿伸腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1899.name: 侧弓步内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1900.name: 站姿屈膝髋内收肌拉伸
1900.englishName: standing bent knee hip adductor stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1901.name: 跪姿俯身内收肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1902.name: 坐姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.

1903.name: 髋外展前屈拉伸
1903.englishName: hip abduction with flexion in front stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1904.name: 站姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1905.name: 仰卧靠墙拉伸
1905.englishName: lying leaning against the wall stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.

1906.name: 单腿外展屈曲拉伸
1906.englishName: abduction of one leg flexion stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1907.name: 辅助仰卧内收肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
Keep your hips level.
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1908.name: 站姿脚尖下压腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1909.name: 站姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1910.name: 站姿抬腿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1911.name: 抬腿膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1912.name: 站姿高抬腿屈膝腘绳肌拉伸
1912.englishName: standing high leg bent knee hamstring stretch
instructions: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1913.name: 跪姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1914.name: 坐姿膝屈肌和髋内收肌拉伸
1914.englishName: seated knee flexor and hip adductor stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.

1915.name: 坐姿膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1916.name: 站姿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1917.name: 站姿交叉腿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
1917.englishName: standing reach down hamstring crossed legs stretch
instructions: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1918.name: 坐姿髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
1918.englishName: seated hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
instructions: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1919.name: 坐姿对侧腿从后方髋部拉伸
1919.englishName: seated hip stretch with opposite leg from behind
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1920.name: 跖屈拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1921.name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1922.name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸(用毛巾)
1922.englishName: recumbent knee flexor stretch with towel
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1923.name: 辅助仰卧腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1924.name: 站姿脚尖上翘小腿拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1925.name: 单脚脚跟下落小腿拉伸
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1926.name: 跖屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
1926.englishName: plantar flexor and foot everter stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1927.name: 跖屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
1927.englishName: plantar flexor and foot inverter stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1928.name: 肋木胫骨屈曲拉伸
1928.englishName: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
instructions: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1929.name: 半屈膝胫骨拉伸
1929.englishName: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1930.name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩小腿拉伸
instructions: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1931.name: 髋膝屈曲深蹲拉伸
1931.englishName: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1932.name: 辅助仰卧位髋部拉伸
1932.englishName: assisted lying hip stretch in supine position
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1933.name: 坐姿屈膝旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1934.name: 坐姿屈膝伸展旋转拉伸
1934.englishName: seated knee up extended rotation stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1935.name: 仰卧交叉膝上拉拉伸
1935.englishName: lying cross over knee pull up stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1936.name: 仰卧交叉膝下拉拉伸
1936.englishName: lying cross over knee pull down stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1937.name: 坐姿屈膝抱胸臀部拉伸
1937.englishName: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1938.name: 坐姿微屈腿髋部拉伸
1938.englishName: seated hip stretch with slightly bent leg
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1939.name: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
1939.englishName: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1940.name: 坐姿脚拉向胸臀部拉伸
1940.englishName: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1941.name: 站姿髋内收拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1942.name: 站姿髂胫束拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1943.name: 鸽式髋部拉伸
instructions: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1944.name: 髋外旋肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1945.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

1946.name: 站姿收腿髋部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1947.name: 站姿髋外侧拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1948.name: 坐姿髋部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1949.name: 站姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1950.name: 髋部屈伸拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

1951.name: 坐姿单腿外侧拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
