2741.englishName: ez-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
收缩二头肌，将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2742.name: 杠杆臀推(用踏箱) v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine with your feet on the step box and the pad across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

2743.name: 杠杆臀推 v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Secure the hip pad over your lap.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control without letting the weight crash.

2744.name: 绳索站姿臀推
instructions: Attach a belt or strap to a low cable and stand facing away from the stack.
Hold the cable at your hips with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge slightly, then thrust your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Return slowly and keep your ribs down.

2745.name: 史密斯机反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hook your heels under the smith bar if it is set low.
Lift your legs by extending the hips until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

2746.name: 杠杆外展深蹲
instructions: Set the machine and step in with the pads on your shoulders.
Squat down with control, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Push your knees slightly outward as you rise.
Keep your core braced.

2747.name: 杠杆内收推举
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads between or around your legs as set.
Brace your core.
Thrust your hips up while squeezing your legs inward.
Hold the squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

2748.name: 杠杆跪姿反向挺身
instructions: Kneel on the machine pad and hold the handles.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Press the leg back and up until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

2749.name: 杠杆辅助腿举
instructions: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform by bending your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to extend the legs.
Do not lock your knees fully.

2750.name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(靠墙支撑)
2750.englishName: dumbbell single leg deadlift with wall support
instructions: Stand near a wall, holding a dumbbell and resting one hand on it for balance.
Lift one leg behind you.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell down your standing leg.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall, then switch legs.

2751.name: 壶铃哑铃相扑深蹲(站在踏箱)
2751.englishName: kettlebell dumbbell sumo squat off stepbox
instructions: Stand on a step box in a wide stance with toes out.
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell in front of you.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Lower as far as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.

2752.name: 分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2753.name: 壶铃弹力带低位全蹲
2753.englishName: kettlebell resistance band full squat from deficit
instructions: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.

2754.name: 负重臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and bend your knees.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2755.name: 绳索髋外展(脚尖朝外)
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

2756.name: 绳索髋外展(脚尖朝内)
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes inward slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

2757.name: 蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2758.name: 绳索起立
instructions: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand fully.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

2759.name: 杠杆侧向髋外展
instructions: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2760.name: 弹力带臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides.
Plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

2761.name: 踝背屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2762.name: 踝跖屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2763.name: 肘伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2764.name: 肘屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2765.name: 前臂旋前
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2766.name: 前臂旋后
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2767.name: 髋外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2768.name: 髋内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2769.name: 髋伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2770.name: 髋屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2771.name: 髋外旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2772.name: 髋内旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2773.name: 膝伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2774.name: 膝屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2775.name: 肩外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2776.name: 肩内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2777.name: 肩伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2778.name: 肩屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2779.name: 肩外旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2780.name: 肩内旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2781.name: 肩水平外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2782.name: 肩水平内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2783.name: 肩水平伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2784.name: 肩水平屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2785.name: 脊柱(腰椎)伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2786.name: 脊柱(腰椎)屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2787.name: 脊柱(腰椎)侧屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2788.name: 脊柱(腰椎)旋转
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2789.name: 腕内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2790.name: 腕伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2791.name: 腕屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2792.name: 平板支撑跳
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

2793.name: 平板支撑行走上撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

2794.name: 波比
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将双手放在身前的地板上，将身体降低至蹲姿。
将脚踢回到俯卧撑位置。
进行俯卧撑，保持身体呈一条直线。
将双脚跳回蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。

2795.name: 哑铃上台阶弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

2796.name: 哑铃上台阶弓步
instructions: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚都踩在台阶上。
推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，同时将左脚抬起。
双脚踩在台阶上后，将左脚放回起始位置，并将右脚保持在台阶上。
重复该动作，每次交替使用哪只脚。
继续进行所需的重复次数。

2797.name: 杠铃深蹲跳后撤弓步 v. 2
2797.englishName: barbell squat jump step rear lunge v. 2
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.

2798.name: 杠铃深蹲跳后撤弓步
2798.englishName: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
向上爆炸，尽可能高地跳离地面。
双脚轻轻落地，然后立即单腿向后退一步，形成反向弓步。
降低身体，直到大腿前侧与地面平行，保持背部挺直。
推动前脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一条腿上重复跳跃和弓步序列。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2799.name: 杠铃坐姿交替抬腿
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能高地抬起，同时将另一条腿放在地上。
将抬起的腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2800.name: 杠铃坐姿交替抬腿(女)
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能抬高，同时保持与地面平行。
将腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2801.name: 扭转抬腿(女)
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，将它们拉向胸部。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将膝盖移向另一侧的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2802.name: 扭转抬腿
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将双腿拉向对面的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2803.name: 哑铃扶持深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2804.name: 哑铃扶持深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.

2805.name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(踏箱支撑)
2805.englishName: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将左脚放在身后的台阶或高架表面上。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，髋部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
当你放下哑铃时，同时将左腿抬起到身后，从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到右腿筋拉伸，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

2806.name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(踏箱支撑) v. 2
2806.englishName: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell and rest the toes of one foot on a step box behind you.
Soften the front knee and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Keep your back flat and go as far as your hamstring allows.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

2807.name: 哑铃相扑穿腿拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall, swinging the dumbbell to hip height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

2808.name: 哑铃相扑穿腿拉
instructions: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
双手握住哑铃置于身体前方，双臂伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将臀部放低至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直。
将哑铃放在两腿之间，保持手臂伸直。
通过脚后跟发力，向前伸展臀部，将哑铃向上拉至身体前方。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部，然后将哑铃放回双腿之间。
重复所需的重复次数。

2809.name: 杠铃分腿蹲 v. 3
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through your front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

2810.name: 杠铃分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，保持躯干直立。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿向前重复此动作，达到所需的重复次数。

2811.name: 杠铃扭腿推举
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
Alternate sides on each rep.

2812.name: 哑铃上台阶分腿蹲
instructions: 站在长凳或台阶前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
走到长凳上或用右脚踩上，用脚跟推动身体抬起。
当你向上迈步时，同时将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢将左脚放回地面，同时将右脚放在长凳或台阶上。
将左脚放在长凳或台阶上，重复该动作。
继续交替左右脚，达到所需的重复次数。

2813.name: 哑铃上台阶分腿蹲
instructions: 站在长凳或台阶前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
走到长凳上或用右脚踩上，用脚跟推动身体抬起。
当你向上迈步时，同时将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢将左脚放回地面，同时将右脚放在长凳或台阶上。
将左脚放在长凳或台阶上，重复该动作。
继续交替左右脚，达到所需的重复次数。

2814.name: 单臂扭转高翻推举
2814.englishName: one arm twisted clean and press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a weight in one hand low in front of you.
Pull it up to your shoulder with a hip drive and a slight turn of the body.
Turn your feet and hips back to face forward as you dip your knees.
Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

2815.name: V字起落(稳定球)
instructions: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

2816.name: V字起落(稳定球)
instructions: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

2817.name: 杠铃滑雪者
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
同时将杠铃举向肩膀，同时稍微离开地面。
当您到达动作的最高点时，快速反转动作并将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2818.name: 哑铃上斜单臂侧平举
2818.englishName: dumbbell incline one arm lateral raise
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
身体前倾，将上臂靠在大腿内侧。
将哑铃举到一侧，保持手臂稍微弯曲，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地板平行。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

2819.name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举 v. 2
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气，同时将手柄向肩膀卷曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

2820.name: 杠杆三头肌伸展 v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2821.name: 稳定球背部伸展(手放脑后)
2821.englishName: exercise ball back extension with hands behind head
instructions: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上。
将脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上以获得支撑。
双臂交叉于脑后，双手触碰后脑勺。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到臀部形成一条直线。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2822.name: 杠杆坐姿反向飞鸟
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，并保持手臂稍微弯曲。
呼气并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，同时向后和向外拉动手柄，使其远离身体。
在收缩峰值时停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2823.name: 深度俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2824.name: 史密斯机前蹲(高翻握法)
instructions: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
面向杠铃站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，将杠铃放在前肩上，放在锁骨和三角肌上。
保持挺胸、背部挺直、核心收紧。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2825.name: 稳定球单腿斜向踢腿腘绳肌弯举
2825.englishName: exercise ball one legged diagonal kick hamstring curl
instructions: 首先仰卧，双腿伸展，脚跟放在稳定球上。
将手臂放在身体两侧以保持稳定。
调动臀肌和核心肌肉，将臀部抬离地面，从肩膀到脚后跟形成一条直线。
弯曲右膝并将其靠近胸部，保持左腿伸展，脚部弯曲。
将右腿斜踢过身体，完全伸展并拉动腿筋。
慢慢地将右腿返回到起始位置，保持控制和稳定性。
用左腿重复该动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

2826.name: 杠铃站姿腹肌滚轮前推
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
启动你的核心肌群，慢慢地将杠铃向地面滚动，保持背部挺直，手臂伸展。
继续向前滚动杠铃，直到身体完全伸展，双手位于头顶正上方。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃向大腿方向滚动，保持控制并保持核心参与。
重复所需的重复次数。

2827.name: 战绳侧举
instructions: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

2828.name: 战绳侧举
instructions: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

2829.name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2830.name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2831.name: 凳上派克俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

2832.name: 凳上派克俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

2833.name: 吊带负重反向划船
instructions: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

2834.name: 吊带负重反向划船
instructions: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

2835.name: 绳索窄距椅上起立
instructions: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.

2836.name: 绳索踏箱直腿硬拉
2836.englishName: cable stiff leg deadlift from stepbox
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

2837.name: 绳索踏箱后撤弓步
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.

2838.name: 自行车
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

2839.name: 抬胸转体
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

2840.name: 控制平衡
instructions: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

2841.name: 开瓶器
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

2842.name: 螃蟹式
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

2843.name: 双腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

2844.name: 地面挺身 v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

2845.name: 扭髋手臂支撑
instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

2846.name: 百次拍击
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

2847.name: 折刀式
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.

2848.name: 侧向拉腿
instructions: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

2849.name: 拉腿
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

2850.name: 抬腿(屈膝)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

2851.name: 仰卧双腿踢
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

2852.name: 侧卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

2853.name: 仰卧拉颈
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

2854.name: 仰卧单腿画圈
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

2855.name: 仰卧单腿踢
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

2856.name: 开腿摇椅
instructions: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

2857.name: 摇摆
instructions: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

2858.name: 卷起 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

2859.name: 向后翻滚
instructions: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

2860.name: 翻转
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

2861.name: 锯式
instructions: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

2862.name: 剪刀腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

2863.name: 肩桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

2864.name: 侧弯
instructions: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

2865.name: 侧踢
instructions: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

2866.name: 侧向扭转
instructions: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

2867.name: 单直腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.

2868.name: 脊柱扭转 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

2869.name: 天鹅俯冲
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

2870.name: 游泳式
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

2871.name: 挑战式
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

2872.name: 单腿伸展(屈膝) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

2873.name: 脊柱前伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

2874.name: 前支撑拉腿
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

2875.name: 跪姿侧踢
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

2876.name: 回旋镖
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

2877.name: 海豹式
instructions: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

2878.name: 俯卧撑起天鹅式
instructions: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

2879.name: 美人鱼式
instructions: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

2880.name: 四点支撑游泳式
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

2881.name: 俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2882.name: 绳索站姿后三角肌划船(用绳)
2882.englishName: cable standing rear delt row (with rope)
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住电缆附件，手掌相对，然后后退以在电缆中产生张力。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将电缆拉向您的身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在运动的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳索回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2883.name: 杠杆坐姿肩部推举
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start near shoulder height and sit with your back on the pad.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height and repeat.

2884.name: EZ杠铃下斜窄握面部推举
2884.englishName: ez barbell decline close grip face press
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头低于脚。
紧紧抓住 ez 杠铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部靠近身体。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃降低到前额。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2885.name: 杠杆T杠划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度和踏板位置以确保正确对齐。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向躯干，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在收缩峰值时暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2886.name: 绳索悬垂抬腿
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

2887.name: 绳索悬垂抬腿
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

2888.name: 海星卷腹(初级)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

2889.name: 海星卷腹(进阶)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

2890.name: 前平板支撑到俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

2891.name: 交替打腿(手放臀下抬头)
2891.englishName: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
instructions: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

2892.name: 剪刀腿(初级)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

2893.name: 剪刀腿(进阶)
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

2894.name: 前平板支撑抬臂
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

2895.name: 前平板支撑抬臂(俯卧撑姿势)
2895.englishName: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

2896.name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(动作检查)
2896.englishName: front plank with arm and leg lift (form check)
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.

2897.name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(俯卧撑姿势)
2897.englishName: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

2898.name: 前平板支撑抬腿
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

2899.name: 侧平板支撑(初级)
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2900.name: EZ杠站姿牧师凳弯举
instructions: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

2901.name: 动力雪橇二头肌弯举
instructions: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

2902.name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步划船
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2903.name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步 v. 2
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2904.name: 动力雪橇后蝙蝠翼
instructions: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

2905.name: 动力雪橇后飞鸟
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.

2906.name: 动力雪橇后拖
instructions: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

2907.name: 动力雪橇倒退推
instructions: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

2908.name: 动力雪橇抗旋转前行
2908.englishName: power sled anti rotation forward walk
instructions: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.

2909.name: 动力雪橇高拉
instructions: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

2910.name: 哑铃单侧负重行走
instructions: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.

2911.name: 哑铃高低负重行走
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.

2912.name: 六角杠农夫行走
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

2913.name: 哑铃过头负重行走
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.

2914.name: 杠铃过头负重行走
instructions: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.

2915.name: 杠铃泽奇负重行走
instructions: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.

2916.name: 壶铃高脚杯负重行走
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back.

2917.name: 哑铃农夫行走
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down and brace your abs.
Walk with quick, controlled steps without swinging the weights.
Cover the set distance, then lower the dumbbells safely.

2918.name: 杠铃单侧负重行走
instructions: Stand with the barbell at your side and grip it near its center of balance.
Lift it while keeping your torso tall and level.
Walk with steady steps and resist tilting toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then lower the bar carefully.
Switch hands and repeat.

2919.name: 史密斯机六角推举
instructions: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Rerack the bar when done.

2920.name: 徒手单腿硬拉(手臂和腿伸直)
2920.englishName: single leg bodyweight deadlift with arm and leg extended
instructions: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

2921.name: 派克俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

2922.name: 徒手站姿二头肌弯举
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2923.name: 脉冲划船
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

2924.name: 绳索侧卧侧平举
instructions: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

2925.name: 哑铃单腿上台阶
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2926.name: X形弹力带侧向行走
instructions: Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.

2927.name: 壶铃跪姿单臂倒握推举
2927.englishName: kettlebell kneeling one arm bottoms up press
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2928.name: 杠铃过头耸肩
instructions: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.

2929.name: 跪姿战绳
instructions: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.

2930.name: 弹力带拉开(旋后90度)
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

2931.name: 背靠墙肩屈曲
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2932.name: 壶铃跪姿单臂肩部推举
2932.englishName: kettlebell kneeling one arm shoulder press
instructions: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2933.name: 战绳后撤弓步
instructions: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.

2934.name: 壶铃半跪姿肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

2935.name: 半跪姿pvc管胸肌活动拉伸
2935.englishName: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

2936.name: 摇摆踝部拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

2937.name: 稳定球圆背滚动
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.

2938.name: 弹力带上肢抗阻死虫式
2938.englishName: band upper body resistance dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.

2939.name: 壶铃绕头旋转
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.

2940.name: 俯卧单臂斜方肌上举
instructions: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2941.name: 前臂靠墙滑动
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.

2942.name: 壶铃斜向推举
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2943.name: 弹力带蜘蛛爬
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.

2944.name: 海豹俯卧撑
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

2945.name: 背靠墙肩胛滑动
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.

2946.name: 单臂肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2947.name: 滚压小腿前侧泡沫轴放松
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.

2948.name: 滚压胸肌泡沫轴放松
instructions: Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

2949.name: 滚压背阔肌泡沫轴放松
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

2950.name: 杠杆腰带深蹲
instructions: Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

2951.name: 杠杆水平腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.

2952.name: 史密斯机跪姿后踢(与搭档)
instructions: Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

2953.name: 绳索站姿反握弯举(直杆)
2953.englishName: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

2954.name: 绳索站姿反握弯举(直杆)
2954.englishName: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

2955.name: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
2955.englishName: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2956.name: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
2956.englishName: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2957.name: 哑铃分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
2957.englishName: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2958.name: 哑铃分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
2958.englishName: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2959.name: 哑铃分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2960.name: 哑铃分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2961.name: 平板支撑俯卧撑划船
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.

2962.name: 杠杆坐姿锤式握肩部推举
2962.englishName: lever seated hammer grip shoulder press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.

2963.name: 罗马椅直腿抬腿
instructions: 坐在船长椅上，背部靠在靠背上，前臂放在扶手垫上。
保持上半身稳定，背部挺直。
收紧腹肌并将双腿抬起到身前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2964.name: 杠铃臀桥(手放杠上)
instructions: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2965.name: 杠铃臀桥(手放杠上)
instructions: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2966.name: 哑铃前蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

2967.name: 哑铃前蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

2968.name: 哑铃推举深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.

2969.name: 哑铃推举深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

2970.name: 弹力带推举深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.

2971.name: 弹力带推举深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.

2972.name: 侧弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

2973.name: 侧弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

2974.name: 杠杆单臂推胸(挂片式)
2974.englishName: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2975.name: 杠杆单臂推胸(挂片式)
2975.englishName: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

2976.name: 地雷管深蹲推举
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

2977.name: 地雷管深蹲推举
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

2978.name: 肘撑上下动态平板支撑
2978.englishName: elbow up and down dynamic plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

2979.name: 肘撑上下动态平板支撑
2979.englishName: elbow up and down dynamic plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

2980.name: 哑铃反向划船
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.

2981.name: 哑铃反向划船
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.

2982.name: 哑铃交替地面推举
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.

2983.name: 哑铃交替地面推举
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.

2984.name: 单腿深蹲至箱
instructions: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2985.name: 单腿深蹲至箱
instructions: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2986.name: 负重锤式握法双杠架引体向上
2986.englishName: weighted hammer grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.

2987.name: 负重窄握反手引体向上(双杠架)
2987.englishName: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
instructions: 站在俯卧撑前面，用反握抓住双杠，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

2988.name: 深蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.

2989.name: 深蹲灵活性组合练习
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.

2990.name: 杠铃行走小腿激活
instructions: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.

2991.name: 滚球坐姿单腿肩部屈伸收缩
2991.englishName: rollball seated single leg shoulder flexor depressor retractor
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.

2992.name: 杠铃小腿自我按摩
instructions: Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.

2993.name: 壶铃高脚杯深蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

2994.name: 小腿前侧自我泡沫轴放松
instructions: Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.

2995.name: 弹力带单臂肩上推举
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.

2996.name: 弹力带单臂肩上推举
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.

2997.name: 弹力带辅助引体向上 v. 3
instructions: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

2998.name: 坐姿踝部拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

2999.name: 弹力带站姿后侧跟腱拉伸
2999.englishName: resistance band standing back achilles stretch
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.

3000.name: 弹力带站姿前侧跟腱拉伸
3000.englishName: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.

3001.name: 深蹲膝盖位置
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

3002.name: 单臂俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.

3003.name: 快走
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

3004.name: 快走
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

3005.name: 弹力带坐姿髋外展
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在椅子或长凳的两侧以获得支撑。
启动外展肌（大腿外侧肌肉），并克服弹力带的阻力，慢慢将膝盖分开。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回一起。
重复所需的重复次数。

3006.name: 弹力带坐姿髋外展
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在椅子或长凳的两侧以获得支撑。
启动外展肌（大腿外侧肌肉），并克服弹力带的阻力，慢慢将膝盖分开。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回一起。
重复所需的重复次数。

3007.name: 弹力带腿屈伸
instructions: 将阻力带固定在坚固的锚点上，并将其固定在脚踝上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
保持核心参与并保持上半身稳定，将腿伸直到身前。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3008.name: 弹力带腿屈伸
instructions: 将阻力带固定在坚固的锚点上，并将其固定在脚踝上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
保持核心参与并保持上半身稳定，将腿伸直到身前。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3009.name: 上楼梯
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

3010.name: EZ杠仰卧屈臂上拉
3010.englishName: ez bar lying bent arms pullover
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
旋前握住 EZ 杠铃（手掌背向您），双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后通过反向弧线运动将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3011.name: 上斜肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将双手放在长凳上，距离略比肩宽。
将双脚放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将胸部向长凳方向降低，保持肘部内收。
当你降低时，缩回肩胛骨，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3012.name: 肩胛臂屈伸
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂在身前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
弯曲肘部并缩回肩胛骨来降低身体，就像你试图在它们之间挤一支铅笔一样。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力，伸展肘部，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3013.name: 地面低位臀桥
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3014.name: 地面低位臀桥
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3015.name: 卷腹起身
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3016.name: 卷腹起身
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3017.name: 杠铃潘德勒划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3018.name: 站姿提踵
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.

3019.name: 凳上引体向上
instructions: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3020.name: 凳上引体向上
instructions: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3021.name: 肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你下降时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将胸部向前推。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3022.name: 弹力带仰卧髋外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.

3023.name: 弹力带仰卧髋内旋 v. 2
3023.englishName: band lying hip internal rotation v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

3024.name: 弹力带穿腿拉
instructions: 将阻力带连接到地面上坚固的锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前迈一步，在弹力带中产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并将臀部向后推，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
向前推动臀部并挤压臀部以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3025.name: 杠铃凳上前蹲
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上胸部，锁骨下方。
正手握住杠铃，保持肘部向上，上臂与地面平行。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，将身体降低到蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
在深蹲底部暂停片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3026.name: 杠铃下斜窄握颅骨推举
3026.englishName: barbell decline close grip to skull press
instructions: 躺在下斜长凳上，头低于脚，紧紧握住杠铃。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃向前额降低，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3027.name: 杠铃拖曳弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，与手臂保持一定距离。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将杠铃向上卷曲至胸部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3028.name: 杠铃杰姆卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3029.name: 杠铃反握腕弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3030.name: 杠铃分腿蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3031.name: 杠铃站姿窄握军事推举
