3031.englishName: barbell standing close grip military press
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手距离略小于肩宽。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

3032.name: 杠铃站姿宽握军事推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握杠铃，握距略宽于肩。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微位于杠铃前方。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3033.name: 杠铃腕弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，前臂放在大腿上，反握杠铃。
让杠铃向下滚动到指尖，保持手腕伸直。
弯曲手腕，慢慢地将杠铃向上卷向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3034.name: 屈腿后踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3035.name: 屈腿侧踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3036.name: 徒手跪姿三头肌伸展
instructions: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3037.name: 后踢腿跑
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

3038.name: 绳索交替肩部推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住绳索机的手柄。
将双手放在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
保持核心参与并保持背部挺直。
向上并向前按下一个手柄，直到您的手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
双臂交替进行所需的重复次数。

3039.name: 绳索交替三头肌伸展
instructions: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
右手握住电缆手柄，抬起手臂，使上臂与地面平行，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，前臂向后伸展，完全伸直手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
用左臂重复此动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

3040.name: 龙门架直杆高位头上三头肌伸展
3040.englishName: cable bar high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.

3041.name: 绳索窄握弯举
instructions: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3042.name: 绳索集中弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部靠在大腿内侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

3043.name: 绳索集中伸展(单膝跪姿)
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
用右手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部放在右膝盖内侧。
充分伸展手臂，保持肘部静止并靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3044.name: 绳索交叉高位下拉
instructions: 将电缆手柄连接到电缆机器两侧与肩同高的位置。
站在机器中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并后退以在电缆中产生张力。
从臀部开始稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手柄向下拉并穿过身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3045.name: 绳索硬拉
instructions: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，降低躯干，直到背部与地面平行。
正手握住电缆手柄，保持手臂伸直，肩膀向后。
调动臀肌和腿筋来抬起拉索手柄，伸展臀部并站直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将缆索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3046.name: 绳索下斜推举
instructions: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
坐在面向缆绳机的下降长凳上。
正手握住手柄并将其置于胸部水平。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部牢牢靠在长凳上。
呼气并将手柄推离身体，充分伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，挤压胸部肌肉。
吸气并慢慢地将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3047.name: 绳索高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
3047.englishName: cable high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，背对机器站立。
双手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸过头顶。
保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3048.name: 龙门架髋外展 v. 2
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

3049.name: 绳索上斜卧推
instructions: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
将电缆手柄连接到高滑轮上。
坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，并将其拉至肩部高度。
向前和向上推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3050.name: 绳索上斜飞鸟
instructions: 将电缆机调整至较低位置并安装手柄。
坐在倾斜的长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以受控的动作向两侧张开双臂。
在完全伸展位置停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3051.name: 绳索上斜下压
instructions: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
稍微向前倾并保持背部挺直。
伸展肘部，将杠铃向下拉向大腿。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3052.name: 绳索上斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 将拉索机调整至低滑轮位置。
将直杆连接到电缆上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，并将手臂伸直过头顶。
稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃放低到脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3053.name: 绳索柔道翻转
instructions: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住电缆手柄，使其与胸部齐平，手掌朝下。
启动你的核心并将你的躯干向右旋转，将电缆拉过你的身体。
当你旋转时，转动后脚并让臀部自然旋转。
充分伸展双臂，将绳索手柄翻转到肩膀上来完成动作。
通过反向运动返回起始位置，将躯干旋转回中心。
在另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3054.name: 绳索侧平举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住电缆手柄。
保持双臂伸直，核心肌群参与。
将手臂向两侧举起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3055.name: 绳索仰卧二头弯举
instructions: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面朝上躺在平坦的长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3056.name: 绳索仰卧伸展上拉(绳索把手)
3056.englishName: cable lying extension pullover (with rope attachment)
instructions: 将绳子连接到缆绳机上，并将滑轮设置在最高位置。
躺在长凳上，头朝向电缆机。
双手握住绳子，将双臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持双臂伸直，在保持控制的同时慢慢将绳子放到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将绳子拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3057.name: 绳索下拉二头弯举
instructions: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气，慢慢将杠铃向大腿方向卷曲，保持手腕伸直。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3058.name: 绳索后三角肌划船(吊环)
instructions: 将马镫手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器站立。
左手抓住手柄，右脚后退一步，身体保持一个轻微的角度。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
左臂伸展，手掌朝下，通过缩回肩胛骨将手柄拉向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压肩胛骨。
慢慢地将手柄释放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用右臂重复练习。

3059.name: 绳索后蹬
instructions: 将手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上，并背对机器站立。
正手握住手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持肘部不动，将手柄拉回身体，在动作结束时挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将手柄返回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3060.name: 绳索俄罗斯转体(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至前方。
稍微向后倾斜，同时保持背部挺直并且核心参与。
将躯干向右扭转，将电缆手柄拉向右臀部。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将电缆手柄拉向左臀部。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。

3061.name: 绳索坐姿推胸
instructions: 将座椅高度和电缆手柄调整至舒适的位置。
坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住电缆手柄，与肩同高。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，充分伸展双臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3062.name: 绳索坐姿弯举
instructions: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
反手抓住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3063.name: 绳索坐姿高位划船(V形把手)
instructions: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住 V 形杆附件，手掌相对，双手与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
通过收缩肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将 V 形杆拉向躯干。
在收缩的顶峰停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3064.name: 绳索坐姿单臂集中弯举
3064.englishName: cable seated one arm concentration curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
呼气时，保持上臂静止并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气时慢慢将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

3065.name: 绳索坐姿过头弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
保持上臂不动，肘部靠近身体两侧。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3066.name: 绳索肩部推举
instructions: 调整绳索机，使手柄位于肩部高度。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，将其提升至肩部水平，肘部弯曲并指向外侧。
向上按压手柄，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

3067.name: 绳索深蹲弯举
instructions: 将电缆手柄连接到电缆机器上的最低设置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
当你蹲下时，将电缆手柄卷向肩膀，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在弯举的顶部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3068.name: 龙门架站姿二头弯举(绳索)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.

3069.name: 绳索直背坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在电缆划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
将电缆手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3070.name: 绳索双臂三头肌后踢
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，向后伸展前臂，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3071.name: 死虫式
instructions: 平躺，双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，使臀部和膝盖形成 90 度角。
接合你的核心和下背部，将你的下背部压入地面。
慢慢地将右臂和左腿放低至地面，保持它们伸直并悬停在地板上方。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
用左臂和右腿重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3072.name: 下斜屈膝反向卷腹
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

3073.name: 哑铃交替肩部推举
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

3074.name: 哑铃二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3075.name: 哑铃窄握推举 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.

3076.name: 哑铃手指弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反手握住，将前臂放在大腿上，手掌朝上。
让哑铃向下滚动到指尖，然后弯曲手指将其卷起。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。

3077.name: 哑铃锤式弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂不动，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

3078.name: 哑铃上斜双臂伸展
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地躺在长凳上，保持哑铃靠近胸部。
完全躺下后，将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3079.name: 哑铃侧卧肩外旋
instructions: 侧躺在平坦的长凳上，上臂靠在身体两侧，肘部弯曲 90 度。
手中握住哑铃，手掌朝下。
保持上臂靠在身体两侧，尽可能缓慢地向上旋转前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3080.name: 哑铃仰卧单臂伸展
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂完全伸展到胸部上方。
以受控的方式将哑铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部短暂暂停，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

3081.name: 哑铃推举(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动双脚，滚动健身球，直到下背部受到球的支撑并且膝盖呈 90 度角。
将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3082.name: 哑铃坐姿提踵
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，并将哑铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的表面（例如台阶或木块）上，脚跟悬在边缘外。
握住哑铃以保持稳定。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3083.name: 哑铃坐姿弯举 v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.

3084.name: 哑铃单臂牧师椅弯举
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.

3085.name: 哑铃站姿单臂弯举(上斜凳上方)
3085.englishName: dumbbell standing one arm curl (over incline bench)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手掌朝前。
将另一只手放在倾斜的长凳上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

3086.name: 肘触膝扭转
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.

3087.name: EZ杠二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，在整个练习过程中保持静止。
保持肘部靠近身体，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3088.name: 蛙跳
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

3089.name: 腹股沟卷腹
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3090.name: 悬垂斜向抬膝
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3091.name: 高抬腿跳步
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.

3092.name: 高抬膝深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

3093.name: 扬达仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3094.name: 开合跳
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3095.name: 侧向跳跃
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

3096.name: 杠杆交替窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
3096.englishName: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.

3097.name: 杠杆俯身划船
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3098.name: 杠杆二头弯举
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上，肘部靠近身体两侧。
呼气并向上弯曲手柄，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3099.name: 杠杆硬拉
instructions: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到您想要的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，并通过脚后跟推动举重。
保持背部挺直，避免圆肩。
在动作的最高点完全伸展臀部，挤压臀部。
以受控的方式降低重量，保持臀肌和腿筋的张力。
重复所需的重复次数。

3100.name: 杠杆高位划船
instructions: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整至舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏平台上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3101.name: 杠杆军事推举
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向上推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁住肘部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3102.name: 杠杆窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
3102.englishName: lever narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.

3103.name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

3104.name: 杠杆反向T杠划船
instructions: 调整杠杆机上的座椅高度和踏板位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3105.name: 杠杆旋转提踵
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
用脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬高脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3106.name: 杠杆坐姿提踵
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
推动脚掌，将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3107.name: 杠杆耸肩
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄并保持手臂伸直。
保持背部挺直，将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3108.name: 增强式开合跳
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.

3109.name: 滑冰步
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.

3110.name: 史密斯机臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3111.name: 史密斯机冲刺弓步蹲
instructions: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
右脚向后退一步，将其放在杠铃上，将脚尖放在杠上。
弯曲左膝，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持背部挺直。
推动左脚跟返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向后退一步。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3112.name: 史密斯机脚尖提升
instructions: 将史密斯机杆调整到一个高度，让您可以舒适地站立，双脚平放在地面上。
将自己置于杠铃下方，肩膀位于杠铃正下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将脚掌放在升高的平台或重量板上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
在整个练习过程中启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3113.name: 分腿开合跳
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.

3114.name: 直腿后踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3115.name: 三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3116.name: 弹力带固定背后反握下拉
instructions: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢释放带子的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3117.name: 弹力带固定背后窄握下拉
3117.englishName: band fixed back close grip pulldown
instructions: 将弹力带固定在您上方的固定点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
坐在面向乐队的长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
紧紧握住弹力带，手掌朝向您。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢地将弹力带释放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

3118.name: 便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3119.name: 便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3120.name: 扶持站姿提踵
instructions: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.

3121.name: 弹力带坐姿挺背划船
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

3122.name: 弹力带坐姿肩上推举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住阻力带，手掌朝前，将其拉至肩部水平。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带降低至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

3123.name: 弹力带坐姿二头弯举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住阻力带，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将阻力带向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢降低阻力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3124.name: 弹力带坐姿胸推
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住阻力带手柄，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向前伸展双臂，将阻力带推离胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3125.name: 弹力带足外旋
instructions: Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3126.name: 弹力带足跖屈
instructions: Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

3127.name: 弹力带足外翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3128.name: 弹力带足内翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

3129.name: 肩胛后缩前伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.

3130.name: 肩胛上提下沉
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.

3131.name: 扶持便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3132.name: 扶持便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。

在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3133.name: 弹力带坐姿肩上推举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住阻力带，手掌朝前，将其拉至肩部水平。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带降低至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

3134.name: 弹力带坐姿二头弯举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住阻力带，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将阻力带向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢降低阻力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3135.name: 弹力带坐姿胸推
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住阻力带手柄，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向前伸展双臂，将阻力带推离胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3136.name: 静态姿势仰卧靠垫
3136.englishName: static position lying back with pad
instructions: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

3137.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠垫
3137.englishName: static position seated back with pad
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

3138.name: 静态姿势站立
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

3139.name: 静态姿势俯卧
instructions: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

3140.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠背
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

3141.name: 鸟狗式 v. 2
instructions: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.

3142.name: 史密斯机相扑深蹲
instructions: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在上背部和肩膀上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3143.name: 弹力带坐姿挺背划船
3143.englishName: resistance band seated straight back row
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸展，将阻力带绕在脚上。
双手握住阻力带的两端，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向后倾斜，锻炼核心肌群。
将阻力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3144.name: 弹力带坐姿挺背划船
3144.englishName: resistance band seated straight back row
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸展，将阻力带绕在脚上。
双手握住阻力带的两端，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向后倾斜，锻炼核心肌群。
将阻力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3145.name: 加强俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，用力推动你的手臂，伸展你的手臂并抬起你的上半身。
在动作的最高点，将上背部推向天花板，从而伸展肩胛骨。
暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3146.name: 加强俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。

暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。

3147.name: 骨盆后倾
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3148.name: 骨盆后倾
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3149.name: 收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3150.name: 辅助收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3151.name: 收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3152.name: 辅助收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

3153.name: 侧踢波比跳
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

3155.name: 自重站姿窄握单臂划船
3155.englishName: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一只手握住哑铃，握姿中立。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3156.name: 自重站姿窄握单臂划船
3156.englishName: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row

3157.name: 自重站姿窄握划船
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将双臂伸直在身前，紧紧抓住杆或手柄。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3158.name: 自重站姿窄握划船

3159.name: 自重站姿单臂划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一手握住哑铃。

让哑铃垂直悬挂在您面前，手臂完全伸展。

3160.englishName: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。

重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

3163.name: 自重站姿划船
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杆或手柄，手掌朝下。

在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3164.name: 自重站姿划船(用毛巾)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在身前。

在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3167.name: 自重蹲姿划船(用毛巾)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你下蹲时，同时将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3168.name: 自重蹲姿划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3169.name: 自重蹲姿划船(用毛巾)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。

instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3171.name: 拳击右勾拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.

3174.name: 杠铃卧推(膝盖成90度)
instructions: Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.

3175.name: 哑铃飞鸟(膝盖成90度)
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

3176.name: 哑铃直臂上拉(膝盖成90度)
3176.englishName: dumbbell straight arm pullover (knees at 90 degrees)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.

3177.name: 杠杆反向挺身
instructions: 调整杠杆机以适合您的身体并将双脚固定在脚垫中。
面朝下躺在机器上，上半身悬在机器边缘，臀部放在垫子上。
双臂交叉放在胸前或放在脑后。
用臀部和腿筋将双腿向上抬起，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3178.name: 稳定球反向背伸(凳上)
3178.englishName: stability ball reverse hyperextension (off a bench)
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

3179.name: 蛙式反向背伸(凳上)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

3180.name: 上斜反向背伸
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3181.name: 自重蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.

3182.name: 负重蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.

3183.name: 杠铃悬垂高翻(膝下) v. 2
3183.englishName: barbell hang clean below the knees v. 2
instructions: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.

3184.name: 杠铃深蹲(悬挂弹力带技术)
instructions: Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.

3185.name: 杠铃卧推(悬挂弹力带技术)
3185.englishName: barbell bench press (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.

3186.name: 杠铃军事推举(悬挂弹力带技术)
3186.englishName: barbell military press (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.

3187.name: 壶铃高脚杯深蹲跳
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.

3188.name: 哑铃直臂上拉(悬挂弹力带技术)
3188.englishName: dumbbell straight arm pullover (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.

3193.name: 臀腿抬升
instructions: 调整臀肌提升机以适合您的身体。
将自己面朝下放在机器上，固定脚踝。
将双手放在胸前或交叉在胸前。
调动腿筋和臀肌，将上半身抬向天花板。
继续抬起，直到身体从头部到脚后跟成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3194.name: 弗兰肯斯坦深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂伸直将杠铃举在身体前方。
保持背部挺直，弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3195.name: 杠杆仰卧双腿屈单腿还原腿弯举
instructions: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将双腿放在脚踝上方的杠杆垫上。
抓住机器两侧的手柄以提供支撑。
保持上半身不动，呼气并将双腿向上弯曲至臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3196.name: 快速小步跑
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3197.name: 高抬腿踏步跑
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3198.name: 之字形跳
instructions: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3199.name: 跳步
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

3200.name: 杠杆俯身V型把手划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住 V 形杆，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将 V 形杆拉向腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放重量回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3201.name: 四分之一仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3202.name: 半程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3203.name: 抱头半程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3204.name: 双臂过头全程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂伸过头顶，保持伸直。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干直立。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3205.name: 地面T字上举
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3206.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式掌心置于大腿下
instructions: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3207.name: 游泳打腿
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3208.name: 俯卧背伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

3209.name: 俯卧背伸并推起
instructions: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

3210.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式双手交扣
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3211.name: 跪姿俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 首先跪在地上，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，使身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，保持核心靠近身体两侧，将身体压向地面。
继续降低，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后伸直手臂，将其推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3212.name: 基础触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3213.name: 左右触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向右弯曲，将右手伸向右脚，同时保持左手向一侧延伸。
返回起始位置，然后腰部向左弯曲，将左手伸向左脚，同时保持右手向侧面延伸。
重复左右弯曲动作达到所需的重复次数。

3214.name: 双臂展开绕圈触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
保持双腿伸直，腰部向前弯曲，右手向下伸向脚趾。
当你向下伸展时，同时将左腿在身后伸直，保持平衡。
返回起始位置，重复该动作，左手伸向脚趾，右腿在身后抬起。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3215.name: 反手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
3215.englishName: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸，并在腿后将它们握在一起。
慢慢地将双手举过头顶，做圆周运动，保持双腿伸直。
继续圆周运动，直到双手触及脚趾。
反转动作并将双手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3216.name: 击胸俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你降低身体时，用右手拍打胸部。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次用左手敲击胸部。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3217.name: 改良印度式俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将身体向地面降低，弯曲肘部并保持核心参与。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心向后转移，并将臀部向上抬向天花板，与你的身体形成一个倒V形。
继续降低身体，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后反向运动，将臀部向下推，并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3218.name: 双手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手合十放在胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双手向脚趾方向以打圈的方式降低，尽量伸得尽可能远，但不要用力。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3219.name: 剪刀跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
跳离地面，同时将右腿交叉到左腿前面。
落地时，快速换腿，将左腿交叉在右腿前面。
继续交替双腿并尽可能快地跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。

3220.name: 跨步跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性向上跳跃，伸展双腿和手臂。
在空中时，将双腿分开，并将双臂向两侧伸出。
双脚分开与肩同宽，轻轻落地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。

3221.name: 半蹲(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3222.name: 半蹲跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性跳跃，伸展臀部和膝盖，同时摆动手臂以获得动力。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3223.name: 星形跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
稍微弯曲膝盖并爆发性地跳起来。
跳跃时，张开双腿，将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体形成星形。
膝盖轻轻弯曲，脚掌轻轻着地。
重复所需的重复次数。

3224.name: 开合跳(男)
instructions: 双脚并拢站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
跳起来，分开双脚，将手臂举过头顶。
当你落地时，迅速跳回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3225.name: 地面T字上举
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3226.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式掌心置于大腿下
instructions: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3227.name: 游泳打腿
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3228.name: 俯卧背伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

3229.name: 俯卧背伸并推起
instructions: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

3230.name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式双手交扣
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3231.name: 双脚触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3232.name: 龙门架站姿后三角肌水平划船(绳索)
3232.englishName: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

3233.name: 龙门架坐姿反握划船
instructions: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

3234.name: 海特哑铃飞鸟
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以宽弧线将哑铃向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3235.name: 龙门架辅助反向腿弯举
instructions: 调整缆绳机，使脚踝附件处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸直，将脚踝固定装置固定在脚踝上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气并慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3236.name: 弹力带跪姿臀推(女)
3236.englishName: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
instructions: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，双脚弯曲。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在臀部或向前伸展以保持平衡。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
当你将膝盖抬离地面时，向前推动臀部并挤压臀部，伸展臀部直到大腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3237.name: 地雷杆侧平举
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在肩膀前面。
保持核心收紧并保持背部挺直，将杠铃向上举起并远离身体，将其提升至肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3238.name: 跪姿平板支撑
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

3239.name: 跪姿平板支撑拍肩(男)
instructions: 从跪姿开始，双手放在地上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸到身后，用脚趾支撑，将身体抬起成平板支撑姿势。
保持核心参与并保持臀部稳定，将一只手抬离地面并拍打另一侧的肩膀。
将手放回地面并用另一只手重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3240.name: 健身球靠墙提踵(两膝间夹网球)
3240.englishName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
instructions: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微位于您的前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在膝盖之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3241.name: 健身球靠墙提踵(两踝间夹网球)
3241.englishName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
在墙壁和下背部之间放置一个健身球。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在脚踝之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3242.name: 仰卧下背拉伸(屈膝)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

3243.name: 仰卧下背拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3244.name: 腹部拉伸
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

3245.name: 脚和踝部左右拉伸
3245.englishName: feet and ankles side to side stretch
instructions: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3246.name: 足部和脚踝旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit with one leg extended or crossed over your knee.
Hold your lower leg steady.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Repeat on the other foot.

3247.name: 足部和脚踝拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

3248.name: 前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3249.name: 双手前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

3250.name: 侧触脚尖
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

3251.name: 侧向双手前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3252.name: 抬膝
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward your chest.
Hold it for a moment.
Lower the foot with control.
Alternate legs.
Keep your standing leg steady and your back straight.

3253.name: 站姿侧弯
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

3254.name: 站姿双侧弯
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

3255.name: 站姿侧弯(屈臂)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Bend one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

3256.name: 站姿双侧弯(屈臂)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

3257.name: 站姿单臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

3258.name: 站姿双臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

3259.name: 站姿交替单臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

3260.name: 站姿甩臂
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

3261.name: 四分之一仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3262.name: 仰卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

3263.name: 仰卧全程抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

3264.name: 侧平板支撑抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3265.name: 跪姿俯卧撑至婴儿式
3265.englishName: kneeling push up to child pose
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

3266.name: 肘撑俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

3267.name: 仰卧单腿抬高
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

3268.name: 仰卧侧向抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

3269.name: 跑跳结合
instructions: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

3270.name: 跑步加开合跳
instructions: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

3271.name: 跑步加半蹲
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

3272.name: 跑步加半蹲跳
instructions: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

3279.name: 脚放凳上地面卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

3280.name: 脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
3280.englishName: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

3281.name: 史密斯机全蹲
instructions: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
松开杠铃并后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
保持胸部挺直，核心参与，通过将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低你的身体，直到你的大腿与地面平行，或者在你的灵活性允许的范围内尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3282.name: 负重脚放凳上地面卷腹
3282.englishName: weighted floor crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3283.name: 负重脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
3283.englishName: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

3285.name: 铁十字拉伸
instructions: 平躺，双臂向两侧伸展。
将双腿抬向天花板，保持伸直。
慢慢地将双腿降低到一侧，旨在用脚接触地板。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后将双腿恢复到起始位置。
在另一侧重复拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3286.name: 负重肌肉上拉
instructions: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续拉起自己，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

3287.name: 肘撑臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部向前滑离长凳，伸直双腿，保持脚后跟着地。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3288.name: 韩式臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂伸展并支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3289.name: 不可能臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3290.name: 负重单手引体向上
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，调动核心力量，将身体拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3291.name: 斯塔尔德推举
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸过头顶。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，同时保持手臂伸过头顶。
当你蹲下时，将手臂向下压向地面，锻炼三头肌。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟站起来，同时将手臂举过头顶。
重复所需的重复次数。

3292.name: 电梯式撑起
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或交叉放在胸前。
保持背部挺直，腰部慢慢向前弯曲，将上半身向地面降低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3293.name: 弓步引体向上
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
当你站起来时，弯曲一只手臂并将肘部移向身体一侧，同时保持另一只手臂伸直。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方并且弯曲的手臂完全弯曲。
有控制地放低自己，伸直弯曲的手臂并在另一侧重复该动作。
每次重复时交替进行。

3294.name: 弓步俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，将另一只手臂伸出到一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3295.name: 前水平举次数
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
保持身体挺直，抬起双腿直至与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，目标是 10-20 秒。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3296.name: 前水平举
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
同时，抬起双腿并将其伸直在您面前，保持身体与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持此位置，以达到完全前杆位置。
要释放，请慢慢降低双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3297.name: 后水平举
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
慢慢抬起双腿，保持伸直，直到身体与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3298.name: 分腿俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚分开。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的肩膀放在你的手上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3299.name: 全俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并缓慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的脚抬离地面。
继续向前移动体重，直到身体与地面平行，并用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双脚放回地面，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3300.name: 倾斜俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体伸直。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，让你的肩膀越过你的手。
向前倾时，保持肘部稍微弯曲，身体伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3301.name: 蛙式俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部挺直。
当你降低身体时，将双脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后向后伸展双腿，并将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3302.name: 倒立
instructions: 找到一个有足够空间的空地来进行倒立。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿向上踢向墙壁，用核心和肩膀保持平衡。
处于倒立位置后，用三头肌来支撑体重。
只要能保持平衡，就保持倒立。
下降时，慢慢将双腿放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

3303.name: 人体旗
instructions: 首先，双手握住一根垂直杆，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
利用核心和上半身的力量，抬起双腿，直到它们与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3304.name: 剥猫式
instructions: 首先，将双臂完全伸展，身体放松地悬挂在杆上。
收紧核心并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
继续将双腿举过头顶，让身体穿过手臂。
一旦双腿完全伸过头顶，就开始将它们放回起始位置。
当你降低双腿时，让你的身体通过手臂向后移动，直到你再次完全伸展手臂悬挂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3305.name: 杠铃推举深蹲
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，与肩同高。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低至蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地通过脚后跟站起来，同时将杠铃压过头顶。
当你回到深蹲位置时，将杠铃降低到肩膀高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

3306.name: 大力士芬戈尔手指
instructions: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

3307.name: 大力士酒桶抛掷
instructions: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.

3308.name: 杠铃负重硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.

3309.name: 杠铃负重胸前深蹲
instructions: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.

3310.name: 杠铃负重卧推
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.

3311.name: 杠铃前蹲(从垫块)
instructions: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.

3312.name: 负重肌肉上拉(单杠)
instructions: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃杆，保持身体挺直。
当你的胸部到达杠铃时，用手向下推并将肘部向后推，将身体提升到杠铃上方。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3313.name: 负重直杠臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己置于双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3314.name: 分腿马耳他十字
instructions: 首先，悬挂在一对环上，双臂完全伸展，身体呈一条直线。
双腿分开，形成跨坐姿势。
启动你的核心并慢慢降低你的身体，直到你的手臂与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3315.name: 全马耳他十字
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸直至两侧。
慢慢向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，直到上半身与地面平行。
启动你的核心并保持这个姿势几秒钟。
通过双脚推动并站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3316.name: 杠铃举重组合
instructions: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

3317.name: 大力士翻车
instructions: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.

3318.name: 360度大回环
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
启动你的核心并以圆周运动摆动你的手臂，同时旋转你的躯干。
继续圆周运动，摆动手臂并旋转躯干，达到所需的重复次数。
记住在整个练习过程中保持呼吸。

3319.name: 哑铃躺地锤式推举
3319.englishName: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

3320.name: 哑铃锤式握法上斜凳双臂划船
3320.englishName: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.

3321.name: 弹力带后束飞鸟
instructions: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.

3322.name: 壶铃硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

3323.name: 壶铃半程土耳其起立
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

3324.name: 弹力带交替上斜胸推并转体
3324.englishName: band alternate incline chest press with twist
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.

3325.name: 弹力带交替低位划船并转体
3325.englishName: band alternate low row with twist
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

3326.name: 弹力带交替高位下拉并转体
3326.englishName: band alternate lat pulldown with twist
instructions: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.

3327.name: 全俯撑俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体高度时，身体向前倾斜，双脚离开地面，用双手保持平衡。
继续降低身体，直到胸部略高于地面。
用手推动并伸展双臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
在整个运动过程中，从头部到脚后跟保持一条直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

3328.name: 杠铃组合直腿硬拉翻举上步
3328.englishName: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
instructions: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.

3329.name: 罗马椅仰卧起坐
instructions: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

3330.name: 屈膝抬腿斜向卷腹
3330.englishName: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

3331.name: 直腿抬腿斜向卷腹
3331.englishName: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

3332.name: 负重稳定球卷腹(全程)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.

3333.name: 哑铃单臂宽握卧推
3333.englishName: dumbbell one arm wide grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.

3334.name: 哑铃单臂地面飞鸟
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

3335.name: 哑铃臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

3336.name: 哑铃V字起
instructions: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

3337.name: 哑铃侧桥
instructions: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.

3338.name: 哑铃单腿直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.

3339.name: 哑铃单臂弓步
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.

3340.name: 哑铃直腿硬拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

3341.name: 哑铃弓步 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

3342.name: 龙门架Y字上举
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.

3343.name: 杠杆侧平举 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.

3344.name: 杠杆夹胸
instructions: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

3345.name: 弹簧握力器腕弯举
instructions: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.

3347.name: 哑铃弯举推举
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

3348.name: 上斜拍肩
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

3349.name: 龙门架前蹲
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.

3350.name: 龙门架侧弓步
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

3351.name: 龙门架弓步
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

3352.name: 龙门架跪姿穿拉
instructions: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.

3353.name: 龙门架单臂高位头上三头肌伸展
3353.englishName: cable one arm high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

3354.name: 龙门架前蹲 v. 2
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.

3355.name: 龙门架侧弓步 v. 2
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3356.name: 龙门架前弓步
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

3357.name: 龙门架坐地绳索划船
3357.englishName: cable seated on floor row with rope
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.

3358.name: 龙门架地面平行握高位下拉
3358.englishName: cable parallel grip lat pulldown on floor
instructions: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

3359.name: 龙门架站姿胸推
instructions: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

3360.name: 熊爬
instructions: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平坦并收紧核心。
同时向前移动右手和左脚，然后是左手和右脚。
继续向前爬行，手脚交替动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并保持核心紧张。
继续所需的距离或时间。

3361.name: 滑冰跳
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向右跳，右脚着地。
落地时，将左腿摆动到右腿后面，并用左脚趾敲击地面。
立即向左侧跳跃，左脚着地。
落地时，将右腿摆动到左腿后面，并用右脚趾敲击地面。
继续交替两侧，跳跃并用每条腿敲击地面。
重复所需的重复次数。

3362.name: 龙门架仰卧窄推
instructions: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3363.name: 龙门架站姿窄推
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.

3364.name: 龙门架坐姿窄推
instructions: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.

3365.name: 夏威夷深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

3366.name: 虾式深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3367.name: 滑冰深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

3368.name: 哑铃摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

3369.name: 战绳交替甩臂深蹲
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

3370.name: 战绳交替甩臂跳跃深蹲
3370.englishName: battling ropes alternate arms jump squat
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.

3371.name: 战绳左右甩臂
3371.englishName: battling ropes side to side arms
instructions: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

3372.name: 战绳交替甩臂侧弓步
3372.englishName: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

3373.name: 战绳向内绕圈
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

3374.name: 战绳向外绕圈
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

3375.name: 战绳飞鸟
instructions: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

3376.name: 战绳开合跳
instructions: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

3377.name: 战绳俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

3378.name: 战绳分腿跳
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.

3379.name: 战绳高波浪
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

3380.name: 战绳低波浪
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

3381.name: 桌下反向划船
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

3382.name: 桌下屈膝反向划船
3382.englishName: inverted row bent knee under table
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3383.name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳上) v. 2
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

3384.name: 战绳力量砸绳
instructions: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

3385.name: 杠杆坐姿腿举 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

3386.name: 杠杆坐姿腿屈伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.

3387.name: 椅间臂屈伸
instructions: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

3388.name: 椅间反向划船
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

3389.name: 椅子辅助仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

3390.name: 椅子支撑下沉式提踵
3390.englishName: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

3391.name: 俯身扭转
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

3392.name: 下沉式窄距深蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

3393.name: 地面仰卧抬腿抬髋
3393.englishName: lying leg hip raise on floor
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

3394.name: 臀部行进
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

3395.name: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举
3395.englishName: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

3396.name: 髋部屈伸拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

3397.name: 哑铃全程摆荡
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.

3398.name: 哑铃前置弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs for each rep.

3399.name: 杠铃前置弓步
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.

3400.name: 哑铃翻举推举
instructions: Stand over two dumbbells and grip them with a flat back.
Pull the weights up explosively and catch them at your shoulders.
Dip slightly and drive them overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the floor with control.
Keep the weights close to your body.

3401.name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳间)
instructions: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

3402.name: 屈体俯卧撑(椅间)
instructions: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
