Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.

3403.name: 站姿Y字上举
instructions: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.

3404.name: 站姿T字上举
instructions: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

3405.name: 站姿W字上举
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

3406.name: 站姿骨盆后倾
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或垂在身体两侧。
调动核心肌肉并向前倾斜骨盆，将下背部推向身后的墙壁。
保持该位置几秒钟，然后松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3407.name: 站姿下身旋转
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.

3408.name: 站姿上身旋转
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.

3409.name: 站姿菲尔普斯
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3410.name: 站姿拧毛巾
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.

3411.name: 站姿髋部绕环
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.

3412.name: 仰卧夹臀
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.

3413.name: 仰卧肩部划扫
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.

3414.name: 仰卧上身旋转
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.

3415.name: 辅助反向腿弯举
instructions: Kneel with your ankles secured and your torso upright.
Use the assistance as needed.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and hands if needed.
Keep your hips extended.

3416.name: 站姿肩部绕环
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

3417.name: 跪姿单臂伸展滚动抬起
3417.englishName: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

3418.name: L型引体向上
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背阔肌和二头肌，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3419.name: 地面L型支撑
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3420.name: 地面V型支撑
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3421.name: 哑铃坐姿俯身臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，从臀部向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
将上臂靠近身体两侧，并保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3422.name: 药球卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

3423.name: 药球卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

3424.name: 海特哑铃飞鸟
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以宽弧线将哑铃向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3425.name: 哑铃躺地锤式推举
3425.englishName: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

3426.name: 负重斯文推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手将杠铃片放在胸前。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌相对。
将配重板直接压在您面前，完全伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将配重板放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3427.name: 哑铃臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

3428.name: 哑铃前平举 v. 3
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

3429.name: 哑铃后三角肌平举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3430.name: 哑铃斯科特推举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩部高度，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3431.name: 哑铃直立划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3432.name: 哑铃W推举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩高，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
将哑铃放低至肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

3433.name: 游泳打腿 v. 2(男)
instructions: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。

3434.name: 游泳打腿 v. 2(男)
instructions: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。

3435.name: 单腿臀桥(直腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

3436.name: 超人式
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

3437.name: 蜘蛛爬行俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将右膝靠近右肘，使其离开地面。
当您将右膝向后拉时，同时弯曲肘部将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，然后将左膝朝向左肘重复此动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3438.name: 下斜抬腿抬髋
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

3439.name: 药球向后抛
instructions: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.

3440.name: 分腿跳上箱
instructions: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

3441.name: 坐姿颈部屈伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

3442.name: 药球站姿过头抛
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.

3443.name: 地面椅子臂屈伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

3444.name: 椅子上台阶
instructions: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

3445.name: 哑铃摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

3446.name: 哑铃V字起
instructions: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

3447.name: 哑铃侧弓步 v. 3
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

3448.name: 哑铃侧弓步 v. 3
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

3449.name: 哑铃俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

3450.name: 哑铃俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

3451.name: 哑铃反向卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握住，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸直向上伸向天花板，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部，让肘部向两侧张开。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3452.name: 哑铃斯文德推举
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

3453.name: 哑铃斯文德推举
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

3454.name: 哑铃超人式
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

3455.name: 哑铃超人式
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

3456.name: 波比跳加俯卧撑
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3457.name: 波比跳加俯卧撑
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

3458.name: 侧劈叉
instructions: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

3459.name: 脉冲上抬
instructions: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

3460.name: 侧平板支撑髋内收(屈膝)
instructions: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

3461.name: 弓步热身(一)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3462.name: 弓步热身(二)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3463.name: 弓步热身(三)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3464.name: 弓步热身(四)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3465.name: 弓步热身(五)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3466.name: 弓步热身(六)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3467.name: 弓步热身(七)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3468.name: 前侧腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

3469.name: 下犬式
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

3470.name: 前弓步(男)
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，将身体降低到弓步位置。
将右膝盖弯曲约 90 度，保持膝盖与脚踝对齐。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

3471.name: 战士式
instructions: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

3472.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

3473.name: 站姿平衡髋外侧拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

3474.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸(双手过头)
3474.englishName: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

3475.name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部拉伸
3475.englishName: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
instructions: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

3476.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部扭转拉伸
3476.englishName: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.

3477.name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部向右拉伸
3477.englishName: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

3478.name: 仰卧屈腿髋部向左扭转拉伸
3478.englishName: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

3479.name: 交替触脚跟侧踢深蹲
3479.englishName: alternate heel touch side kick squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

3480.name: 交替短跑式弓步
instructions: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

3481.name: 分腿短跑式低弓步
instructions: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

3482.name: 分腿短跑式高弓步
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

3483.name: 环绕世界超人式保持
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

3484.name: 肘触膝仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

3485.name: 椅间屈膝反向划船
3485.englishName: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

3486.name: 椅间屈膝反向下巴弯举
3486.englishName: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

3487.name: 椅间屈膝引体向上
3487.englishName: pull up with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

3488.name: 眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

3489.name: 跪姿眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

3490.name: 下斜跪姿箱上俯卧撑
3490.englishName: decline kneeling push up on box
instructions: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

3491.name: 靠墙下斜俯卧撑
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

3492.name: 跪姿旋转俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

3493.name: 单腿低箱深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3494.name: 单腿触脚跟深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3495.name: 仰卧地面屈膝划船
3495.englishName: lying floor row with bent knee
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

3496.name: 仰卧直腿踏步
instructions: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

3497.name: 地面毛巾滑动下拉
instructions: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

3498.name: 地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
3498.englishName: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

3499.name: 自我辅助反向上拉
instructions: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

3500.name: 全蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

3501.name: 前平板支撑抬腿
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

3502.name: 前后摆腿
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

3503.name: 肘触膝侧平板支撑卷腹
3503.englishName: elbow to knee side plank crunch
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3504.name: 站姿平衡股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

3505.name: 骆驼式
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

3506.name: 门框自重划船
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

3507.name: 自我辅助反向腿弯举 v. 2
3507.englishName: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

3508.name: 弹力带坐姿单腿弯举
3508.englishName: resistance band seated single leg curl
instructions: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3509.name: 地面坐姿开合抬腿
3509.englishName: seated in out leg raise on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

3510.name: 地面蛙式卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

3511.name: 弹力带鸟狗式
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

3512.name: 弹力带上身死虫式
3512.englishName: resistance band upper body dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.

3513.name: 弹力带背后肩部拉伸
3513.englishName: resistance band shoulder stretch behind the back
instructions: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3514.name: 单腿地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
3514.englishName: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3515.name: 地面斜向V字起
instructions: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

3516.name: 肩部后弯拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3517.name: 脊柱后弯拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

3518.name: 弹力带坐姿腿屈伸
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3519.name: 弹力带坐姿腿屈伸
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3520.name: 椅间反向划船
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

3521.name: 哑铃单腿深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
向前伸展一条腿，并在整个练习过程中保持其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚跟推动回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3522.name: 壶铃单腿臀桥上拉
3522.englishName: kettlebell single leg glute bridge pullover
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.

3523.name: 双腿凳上臀桥(男)
3523.englishName: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘，背靠着长凳，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3524.name: 弹力带水平帕洛夫推举加弹力带深蹲
3524.englishName: band horizontal pallof press with resistance band squat
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3525.name: 地雷杆跪姿单臂肩上推举
3525.englishName: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press
instructions: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

3526.name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性练习
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

3527.name: 下犬式触脚尖
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

3528.name: 下犬式脊柱灵活性练习
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

3529.name: 地雷杆站起高抬膝
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.

3530.name: 杠铃弹力带深蹲
instructions: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.

3531.name: 交替出拳
instructions: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

3532.name: 拳击手滑步
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

3533.name: 股四头肌
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3534.name: 自重站姿脉冲提踵
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

3535.name: 自重脉冲深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

3536.name: 三椅间抬高反向划船
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

3537.name: 三椅间抬高反手握反向划船
3537.englishName: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

3538.name: 椅间反手握反向划船
3538.englishName: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

3539.name: 仰卧胸椎灵活性拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

3540.name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性拉伸
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

3541.name: 哑铃上斜Y字上举
instructions: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
稍微向前倾，让手臂伸直垂下，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将手臂向两侧抬起并呈 Y 形，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3542.name: 哑铃上斜T字上举
instructions: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
向前倾斜，让手臂笔直向下垂，垂直于地板。
保持手臂伸直，将它们向两侧举起，直到与地板平行，与身体形成“T”形。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3543.name: 自重落地跳深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起来，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将双脚并拢。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即回到蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。

3544.name: 自重上斜侧平板支撑
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放回到地面，然后在另一侧重复。

3545.name: 哑铃上斜交替推举
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
到达肩膀高度后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
用胸部和肩膀将哑铃向上推，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。

3546.name: 哑铃坐姿交替肩推
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，将哑铃举至肩高。
将一个哑铃举过头顶，同时将另一个哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置。
将举起的哑铃放回肩高，同时将另一个哑铃推过头顶。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

3547.name: 哑铃坐姿二头弯举至肩上推举
3547.englishName: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
前臂垂直后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
通过反向运动将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3548.name: 哑铃单臂过头负重行走
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
向前行走时，启动核心肌群并保持背部挺直，将哑铃举过头顶。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
交换双手并重复练习。

3549.name: 杠杆式髋推(插片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

3550.name: 椅间坐姿引体向上
instructions: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

3551.name: 侧向折返跑
instructions: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

3552.name: 快速小步跑 v. 2
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
首先快速上下移动双脚，就像原地跑步一样。
保持动作快速而轻盈，重点放在脚掌上。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3553.name: 旋转俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

3554.name: 瓶装锤式弯举
instructions: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

3555.name: 爆发式推离
instructions: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

3556.name: 高抬腿跑
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3557.name: 跪姿宽距俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

3558.name: 毛巾仰卧二头弯举
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

3559.name: 毛巾超人式划船
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

3560.name: 哑铃站姿交替锤式弯举加推举
3560.englishName: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，背部挺直。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复卷发动作。
左手完成弯举后，呼气，将右手的哑铃压过头顶。
完全伸展手臂并在顶部保持片刻。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复按压。
继续交替进行弯举和推举，达到所需的重复次数。

3561.name: 臀桥行进
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将一只脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将脚放回地面，然后用另一条腿重复该动作。
继续交替双腿进行行进动作，同时保持桥式姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。

3562.name: 杠铃双腿凳上臀桥(男)
3562.englishName: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: 首先坐在长凳边缘，上背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，与臀部同宽。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀肌和核心肌肉，然后用脚后跟将臀部抬离长凳，形成从膝盖到肩膀的一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3563.name: 龙门架单臂下拉
instructions: 将单个手柄连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并完全伸展手臂。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄向一侧拉，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压背阔肌。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手臂重复练习。

3564.name: 坐姿肩部屈伸收缩拉伸(屈膝)
3564.englishName: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3565.name: 桥式瑜伽拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

3566.name: 滚动上背
instructions: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.

3567.name: 滚动仰卧髋外旋与髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
3567.englishName: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3568.name: 球滚梨状肌放松
instructions: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.

3569.name: 球滚胸肌放松
instructions: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.

3570.name: 球滚上斜方肌放松
instructions: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.

3571.name: 壶铃全程摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

3572.name: 壶铃严格推举
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3573.name: 壶铃索茨推举
instructions: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.

3574.name: 壶铃前弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

3575.name: 壶铃后弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

3576.name: 壶铃农夫行走
instructions: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.

3577.name: 壶铃弓步翻举推举
instructions: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.

3578.name: 壶铃弹弓
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.

3579.name: 壶铃地面深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.

3580.name: 壶铃深度俯卧撑
instructions: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

3581.name: 弓步抬腿
instructions: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

3582.name: 弓步跳
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
右脚蹬地，跳到空中，在空中改变脚的位置。
左脚向前轻柔落地，并立即将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续在弓步和跳跃之间交替进行所需的重复次数。

3583.name: 单腿桥式屈髋
3583.englishName: single leg bridge with hip flexion
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

3584.name: 侧桥摆臂摆腿
3584.englishName: side bridge with arm leg swing
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

3585.name: 单腿硬拉提膝
3585.englishName: single leg deadlift with knee lift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3586.name: 剪刀腿(进阶)
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

3587.name: 负重单腿抬起
instructions: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

3588.name: 原地快速摆臂
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3589.name: 原地快速小跑
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

3590.name: 交替地面仰卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

3591.name: 弹力带扭转
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

3592.name: 杠铃弯举
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续抬高杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3593.name: 杠铃深蹲
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

3594.name: 杠铃直腿硬拉
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲臀部，将杠铃放低至地面，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
降低杠铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸。
启动腿筋和臀肌，将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3595.name: 杠铃宽握直立划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，呼气，将杠铃向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3596.name: 绳索单臂高位下拉
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

3597.name: 绳索单臂扭转坐姿划船
3597.englishName: cable one arm twisting seated row
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

3598.name: 绳索坐姿宽握划船
instructions: 坐在电缆划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手宽握握住手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
将手柄拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3599.name: 胸部双杠臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3600.name: 反手引体向上(窄距平行握)
instructions: 用狭窄的平行握距悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向您。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3601.name: 哑铃铁十字
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
将双臂向两侧举起，直至与地面平行，与身体形成T字形。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3602.name: 哑铃仰卧仰面弯举
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3603.name: EZ杠铃反重力推举
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌朝前。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3604.name: 悬垂直腿抬髋
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3605.name: 地雷管180度
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住杠铃于胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖并将躯干向右旋转，将杠铃向下朝右臀部摆动。
当你到达动作的底部时，快速反向运动并向左旋转你的躯干，向上摆动杠铃并穿过你的身体朝向左肩。
继续这个扭转动作，两侧交替，达到所需的重复次数。

3606.name: 腿屈伸卷腹(稳定球)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.

3607.name: 杠杆背部伸展
instructions: 调整机器以适合您的身体尺寸和运动范围。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚固定。
将手放在手柄或握杆上。
启动你的核心并慢慢向前倾斜，让你的背部稍微弯曲。
在底部位置暂停片刻，感觉下背部有拉伸感。
使用背部肌肉，慢慢将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3608.name: 杠杆上斜锤式胸推
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

3609.name: 杠杆跪姿腿弯举
instructions: 调整机器以适合您的身体并选择所需的重量。
面朝下跪在机器上，膝盖放在垫子上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气，慢慢将双腿放回起始位置，充分伸展膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

3610.name: 杠杆仰卧推胸(挂片式)
instructions: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

3611.name: 杠杆坐姿髋外展
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖成 90 度角。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将手放在侧手柄上以保持稳定性。
启动外展肌并慢慢将双腿分开，远离身体中线。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3612.name: 杠杆坐姿髋内收
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将脚放在脚踏板上并抓住手柄以保持稳定。
收紧内收肌，慢慢将双腿并拢，挤压大腿内侧。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3613.name: 杠杆站姿后踢
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3614.name: 杠杆三头肌伸展
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，并将手臂完全伸展到身前。
保持上臂不动，弯曲肘部，慢慢将手柄向前额降低。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将手柄推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3615.name: 反握器械高位下拉
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖位于垫子下方，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐直，挺胸，肩膀向后，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将手柄向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3616.name: 雪橇45度窄站距腿举
3616.englishName: sled 45 degrees narrow stance leg press
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

3617.name: 雪橇45度宽站距腿举
3617.englishName: sled 45 degrees wide stance leg press
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

3618.name: 史密斯机硬拉
instructions: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，保持背部挺直，挺胸，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
伸展臀部和膝盖，调动核心力量并举起杠铃，保持杠铃靠近身体。
站直，充分伸展臀部和膝盖。
通过弯曲臀部和膝盖来降低杠铃，保持控制并保持背部挺直。
重复所需的重复次数。

3619.name: 史密斯机腿举
instructions: 将史密斯机的座椅和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
伸展双腿，使背部紧靠靠背，将脚踏板推离您。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将脚踏板向您的方向放低，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3620.name: 史密斯机坐姿肩部推举
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使手柄与肩部齐平。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，将其提离支撑物，充分伸展双臂。
将手柄降低至肩部水平，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将手柄向上推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

3621.name: 扭转卷腹(直臂)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

3622.name: V字起
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.

3623.name: 垂直抬腿(双杠) v. 3
3623.englishName: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 3
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.

3624.name: 椭圆机步行
instructions: 将椭圆机的阻力水平和倾斜度调整到您想要的设置。
踩上机器的踏板并轻轻握住手柄。
首先用脚向下压，然后将手柄拉向身体。
继续这个动作，交替推和拉，以模拟行走或跑步动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的步伐并保持核心参与。
继续进行有氧运动所需的持续时间。
下车前逐渐降低机器的强度和速度。

3625.name: 步行波浪机
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.

3626.name: 负重站姿弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并在将哑铃弯举至肩部水平时呼气。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3627.name: 宽握引体向上
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离比肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3628.name: 宽握颈后引体向上
instructions: 正手宽握抓住引体向上杆，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3629.name: 杠杆侧平举
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄并保持手臂伸直。
呼气并将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3630.name: 站姿腘绳肌和背部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3631.name: 坐姿相扑灵活性拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.

3632.name: 坐姿相扑向右扭转拉伸
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3633.name: 坐姿相扑向左扭转拉伸
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3634.name: 坐姿相扑双臂上举灵活性拉伸
3634.englishName: sitting sumo with arms up mobility stretch
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.

3635.name: 哑铃对侧前弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直并启动核心。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
交替腿进行所需的重复次数。

3636.name: 靠墙高抬腿
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在墙上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将右膝抬向胸部，同时将左脚保持在地面上。
快速换腿，将左膝抬向胸部，然后将右脚放低。
继续交替双腿进行跑步动作，将膝盖尽可能抬高。
在整个练习过程中保持快节奏并保持上半身稳定。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3637.name: 滚轮跑
instructions: 从平板支撑位置开始，双手放在方向盘上，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并通过伸展双臂开始向前滚动轮子。
继续滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
使用你的核心和手臂将轮子拉回你的身体，从而扭转运动。
重复所需的重复次数。

3638.name: 推进跑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
用手推动以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
快速将一个膝盖靠近胸部，然后快速切换并将另一只膝盖靠近胸部。
继续尽可能快地交替膝盖，同时保持良好的姿势。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3639.name: 屈膝仰卧扭转(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体垂直。
保持膝盖并拢，慢慢地将它们降低到一侧，旨在用膝盖接触地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并慢慢将膝盖抬回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3640.name: 触膝卷腹
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，并将右手伸向左膝盖。
返回起始位置并重复，这次将左手伸向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3641.name: 负重跪姿上步摆荡
instructions: 从跪姿开始，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，背部挺直。
每只手各握一个重物，双臂在身前笔直向下伸展。
启动你的核心肌群，将重物向上举过头顶，保持手臂伸直。
将重量放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3642.name: 负重拉伸弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直。
弯曲膝盖降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

3643.name: 负重哥萨克深蹲(男)
instructions: 站立时双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
将您的体重转移到一侧，并通过弯曲您转移一侧的膝盖来降低身体，同时保持另一条腿伸直。
尽可能降低身体高度，同时保持平衡并挺胸。
推动弯曲腿的脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，双腿之间交替。

3644.name: 负重弓步摆荡
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个重物。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前冲时，向前和向上摆动重物，保持手臂伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置，将重物向下摆动。
用左脚重复上述动作，并继续交替双腿，完成所需的重复次数。

3645.name: 单腿桥式伸腿
3645.englishName: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将一条腿伸直在您面前。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3646.name: EZ杠铃仰卧三头肌伸展
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

3647.name: 杠杆坐姿抬腿卷腹
instructions: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
抓住手柄或侧杆以保持稳定性。
收紧腹肌，慢慢地将双腿抬向胸部，同时向前卷曲躯干。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低双腿和躯干回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3648.name: 杠铃高翻推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在你面前的地板上。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链降低并用正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
通过脚后跟发力，伸展臀部和膝盖，将杠铃抬离地板，使其靠近身体。
当杠铃到达大腿时，爆发性伸展臀部，耸肩，并将杠铃拉向胸部。
当杠铃到达胸部高度时，迅速将其降至肩部水平，肘部向前，手掌朝上。
从接球位置开始，伸展双臂并将杠铃笔直向上推，将杠铃压过头顶。
将杠铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3649.name: 杠杆站姿髋伸展
instructions: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

3650.name: 跳箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.

3651.name: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉死亡行进
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.

3652.name: 六角杠分腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish reps, then switch the stance.

3653.name: 弹力带辅助短跑跑步
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.

3654.name: 杠铃架上俯卧划船
instructions: Set a barbell on a rack at a height you can reach lying down.
Lie under it and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.

3655.name: 高抬膝行走弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
将右膝尽可能高地抬向胸部，同时用左腿保持平衡。
右脚向前迈出一步，身体降低成弓步姿势，双膝弯曲成 90 度角。
用右脚推出，并将左膝抬向胸部。
左脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续交替双腿并向前冲刺，保持核心参与并保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。

3656.name: 小步幅跑
instructions: 找一个空地或跑步机来进行锻炼。
站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
开始原地慢跑，抬起膝盖并挥动手臂。
几秒钟后，开始小步前进，保持快速的步伐。
继续小步跑所需的时间或距离。

3657.name: 静态姿势仰卧靠垫
3657.englishName: static position lying back with pad
instructions: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

3658.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠垫
3658.englishName: static position seated back with pad
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

3659.name: 静态姿势站立
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

3660.name: 静态姿势俯卧
instructions: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

3661.name: 静态姿势坐姿靠背
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

3662.name: 屈体转眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，与身体形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，使上半身靠近地面，使上半身靠近地面。
当你下降时，将你的重心向前移动，并通过伸直手臂并抬起胸部来过渡到眼镜蛇姿势。
通过弯曲肘部并将胸部放回到地面来扭转运动。
双手用力推回到倒V字形。
通过将臀部放回地面继续运动，回到起始俯卧撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3663.name: 反向平板支撑抬腿
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向脚部。
双手用力，将臀部抬离地面，进入反向平板支撑位置。
启动你的核心并将一条腿抬离地面，将其笔直向上伸向天花板。
保持一会儿，然后将腿放下。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

3664.name: 哑铃侧平板支撑后束飞鸟
3664.englishName: dumbbell side plank with rear fly
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
用你的上手握住哑铃，手臂垂直向下伸向地面。
收紧核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将哑铃向天花板方向举起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3665.name: 力量点平板支撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
启动你的核心并挤压你的臀肌以保持稳定的位置。
将身体放低到前臂上，一次一只手臂，从头到脚保持一条直线。
保持这个姿势所需的时间，保持核心肌群和臀肌的参与。
要返回到起始位置，请推动前臂并将身体抬回到高位平板支撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3666.name: 坡度跑步机行走
instructions: 将跑步机的倾斜度调整到您想要的强度。
站在跑步机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始以舒适的步伐行走，确保保持正确的姿势。
在整个练习过程中，调动核心肌肉并保持背部挺直。
继续在倾斜跑步机上行走，完成有氧运动所需的时间。
逐渐降低跑步机的坡度和速度，使其冷却后再停止。

3667.name: 侧卧髋内收(男)
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动内收肌并尽可能高地抬起上面的腿，但不要旋转臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3668.name: 哑铃躺地胸推
3668.englishName: dumbbell lying on floor chest press
instructions: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

3669.name: 站姿弓步拉弓
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高，与地面平行。
将躯干向右旋转，保持双臂伸展，背部挺直。
旋转时，向前伸展右臂，向后伸展左臂，模仿拉弓弦的动作。
保持该姿势片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将躯干向左旋转，左臂向前伸展，右臂向后伸展。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3670.name: 负重下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲，直到躯干垂直于地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3671.name: 滑雪步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖并保持背部挺直。
跳到右侧，右脚着地，同时将左腿摆动到右腿后面。
立即向左侧跳，左脚着地，同时将右腿摆动到左腿后面。
继续从一侧到另一侧交替跳跃，模仿滑雪动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3672.name: 前后步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置。
用右脚蹬地，然后回到起始位置。
用左脚重复该动作，每一步交替双腿。
继续来回走动，保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3673.name: 站姿(姿势检查)正面
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

3674.name: 站姿(姿势检查)侧面
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

3675.name: 左右跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

3676.name: 跳步跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.

3677.name: 高抬腿跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.

3678.name: 高跳跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.

3679.name: 双臂抱胸仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双臂交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3680.name: 壶铃正手握摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.

3681.name: 哑铃夹紧卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.

3682.name: 哑铃上斜交替二头弯举
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

3683.name: 哑铃高脚杯屈膝礼弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.

3684.name: 哑铃外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

3685.name: 哑铃胸部支撑侧平举
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

3686.name: 哑铃跪姿保持至站起
instructions: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.

3687.name: 哑铃拖曳弯举
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

3688.name: 哑铃坐姿反握二头弯举
3688.englishName: dumbbell seated reverse grip biceps curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.

3689.name: 哑铃坐姿单臂前平举
3689.englishName: dumbbell seated one arm front raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3690.name: 哑铃健身球坐姿肩上推举
3690.englishName: dumbbell seated on exercise ball shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

3691.name: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3692.name: 哑铃高脚杯箱式深蹲
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.

3693.name: 哑铃凳上支撑外旋
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3694.name: 哑铃上斜交替反向飞鸟
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.

3695.name: 哑铃交替卧推(高位起始)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.

3696.name: 哑铃俯身交替后三角肌飞鸟
3696.englishName: dumbbell bent over alternate rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

3697.name: 龙门架跪姿后三角肌划船(绳索)(男)
3697.englishName: cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) (male)
instructions: 将绳索手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器跪下。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，通过收缩肩胛骨将绳子拉向身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起并保持短暂的停顿。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3698.name: 尺蠖爬行 v. 2
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
保持双腿伸直，将脚移向双手，将臀部抬向天花板。
继续向前移动双手，重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

3699.name: 拍肩
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右手抬离地面，伸手拍打你的左肩。
将右手放回地面，然后用左手轻拍右肩，重复此操作。
继续交替轻拍肩膀，同时保持臀部和躯干稳定。
重复所需的重复次数。

3700.name: 团身跳 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.

3701.name: 高抬腿冲刺
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.

3702.name: 前脉冲弓步双手过头
3702.englishName: forward pulse lunge with hands overhead
instructions: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.

3703.name: 青蛙跳爬
instructions: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.

3704.name: 双次跳跃深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

3705.name: 深蹲伸腿
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.

3706.name: 深蹲团身跳
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.

3707.name: 哑铃推举深蹲(大腿)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

3708.name: 有氧弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

3709.name: 哑铃过头深蹲
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.

3710.name: 哑铃分腿蹲前脚抬高(波速球)
3710.englishName: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated with bosu ball
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3711.name: 单腿上台阶 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3712.name: 站姿单腿提踵(扶持)
3712.englishName: standing single leg calf raise with support
instructions: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3713.name: 哑铃站姿单腿提踵 v. 2
3713.englishName: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3714.name: 单腿站立
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

3715.name: 波速球单腿站立
3715.englishName: single leg stand on bosu ball
instructions: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

3716.name: 分腿蹲加翻滚
instructions: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.

3718.name: 分腿侧蹲加翻滚
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.

3719.name: 龙门架站姿高位交叉三头肌伸展
3719.englishName: cable standing high cross triceps extension
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3720.name: 楼梯跳
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

3721.name: 杠铃俯身宽握划船
3721.englishName: barbell bent over wide grip row
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

3722.name: 杠铃上斜俯卧后三角肌上举
3722.englishName: barbell incline lying rear delt raise
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Lower the barbell slowly.

3723.name: 杠铃屈膝礼弓步
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.

3724.name: 杠铃地面胸推
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up to full extension.

3725.name: 杠铃过头弓步
instructions: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.

3726.name: 杠铃坐姿前平举
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.

3727.name: 杠铃凳上前蹲
instructions: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.

3728.name: 杠铃前置上台阶
instructions: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3729.name: 杠铃稳定球胸推
3729.englishName: barbell chest press on stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
