Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

8433.name: 椅上坐姿前屈拉伸
8433.englishName: seated forward bend stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

8434.name: 椅上坐姿前卷起
8434.englishName: seated forward roll up on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

8479.name: 波速球平衡配重滑冰深蹲
8479.englishName: bosu ball balance counterbalanced skater squat
instructions: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

8502.name: 哑铃跪姿对侧肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8505.name: 哑铃跪姿扭转下上举
8505.englishName: dumbbell kneeling twist down up raise
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8508.name: 稳定球死虫式
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the ball above your chest with your knees raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg away, holding the ball with the rest.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides slowly.

8533.name: 跪姿到站姿深蹲
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

8536.name: 徒手靠墙提胫骨
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

8546.name: 俯卧Y到T到W
8546.englishName: lying prone y to t to w
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.

8585.name: 中背部夹肘
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

8604.name: 杠杆式坐姿腿弯举(插片式)
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

8608.name: 弹力带相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

8610.name: 中式平板支撑
instructions: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

8611.name: 弹力带坐姿足外翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

8612.name: 弹力带坐姿足内翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

8613.name: 哑铃牧师凳摆动弯举
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

8614.name: 绳索站姿单臂水平三头肌伸展
8614.englishName: cable standing single arm horizontal triceps extension
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

8615.name: 椅上坐姿交替动态胸部拉伸
8615.englishName: seated alternate dynamic chest stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

8616.name: 椅上坐姿肘部夹胸飞鸟
8616.englishName: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

8617.name: 椅上坐姿外旋
8617.englishName: seated external rotation on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

8618.name: 椅上坐姿推胸
8618.englishName: seated chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

8619.name: 椅上坐姿手臂交叉
8619.englishName: seated arm crossover on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

8620.name: 椅上坐姿下斜推胸
8620.englishName: seated decline chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

8621.name: 椅上坐姿蝴蝶机夹胸
8621.englishName: seated pec dec on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

8622.name: 椅上坐姿上斜推胸
8622.englishName: seated incline chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

8633.name: 椅上坐姿肩部推举
8633.englishName: seated shoulder press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

8634.name: 椅上坐姿旋转拳击滚动
8634.englishName: seated rotating boxing rolls on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

8652.name: 椅上坐姿点肩
8652.englishName: seated shoulder tap on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

8653.name: 椅上坐姿展开与下摆
8653.englishName: seated open up and under swing on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

8654.name: 椅上坐姿过头三头肌伸展
8654.englishName: seated overhead triceps extension on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

8655.name: 椅上坐姿反握手臂画圈
8655.englishName: seated underhand arm circle on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

8660.name: 雪橇侧向腿举
instructions: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8661.name: 绳索上斜Y字上举(背部支撑)
8661.englishName: cable incline y raise with back support
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.

8662.name: 绳索上斜窄握肩部推举(V形把手)
8662.englishName: cable incline close grip shoulder press with v bar
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.

8663.name: 绳索上斜Y字上举腕带(背部支撑)
8663.englishName: cable incline y raise wrist straps with back support
instructions: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.

8664.name: 哑铃屈膝礼弓步蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

8701.name: 负重包行走弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.

8702.name: 扭矩坦克推
instructions: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

8703.name: 战绳拉
instructions: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

8704.name: 波比跳上箱
instructions: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

8712.name: 杠杆式罗马尼亚硬拉(插片式)
instructions: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

8744.name: 椅上坐姿交替伸膝
8744.englishName: seated alternate knee extension on chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

8750.name: 吊环上拉
instructions: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.

8755.name: 分腿蹲提踵
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

8798.name: 杠铃架上海豹划船
8798.englishName: barbell lying seal row on rack
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

8799.name: 杠杆式单腿硬拉(哈克深蹲机)
8799.englishName: leverage single leg deadlift on hack squat machine
instructions: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

8800.name: 史密斯错位站姿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.

8839.name: 肩外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

8847.name: 杠杆式站姿侧平举
instructions: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Keep your torso upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

8873.name: 负重哑铃仰卧屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

8874.name: 弹力带快速踏步
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.

8875.name: 绳索仰卧单腿屈髋
8875.englishName: cable lying single leg hip flexion
instructions: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

8876.name: 绳索仰卧屈髋(反向深蹲)
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

8877.name: 弹力带手指伸展
instructions: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.

8878.name: 绳索45度反向飞鸟
instructions: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.

8879.name: 绳索半跪外旋推举
8879.englishName: cable half kneeling external rotation press
instructions: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

8880.name: 绳索站姿直拳
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

8881.name: 绳索前臂旋前
instructions: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

8882.name: 中立握腕力器
instructions: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.

8891.name: 负重包早安式体前屈
instructions: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.

8892.name: 壶铃错位站姿硬拉
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch stances after your set.

8893.name: 壶铃分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and take a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

8894.name: 屈膝收腿俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.

8895.name: 45度背部伸展肩胛内收
instructions: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.

8896.name: 俯身背部伸展肩胛内收
8896.englishName: bent over back extension scapular adduction
instructions: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

8899.name: 绳索站姿Y字上举 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

8900.name: 绳索站姿直拳 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
Repeat, then switch arms.

8901.name: 绳索单臂侧平举 v. 2
8901.englishName: cable single arm lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

8916.name: 左右跳 v. 2
instructions: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.

8946.name: 坐姿单腿抬起
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

8956.name: 脚跟靠墙深蹲滑行
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

8971.name: 侧弓步拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

8987.name: 半跪侧弓步蹲
instructions: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

8990.name: 杠杆式侧坐单臂后三角肌飞鸟
8990.englishName: lever side seated single arm rear delt fly
instructions: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8991.name: 杠铃泽奇背部伸展
instructions: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid hyperextending at the top.
Use a light weight and control the bar.

9002.name: 鸟狗平板支撑
instructions: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

9009.name: 稳定球反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.

9010.name: 稳定球药球卷腹
9010.englishName: medicine ball crunch on stability ball
instructions: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause at the top.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.

9024.name: 仰卧腹部剪刀卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.

9025.name: 稳定球坐姿伐木
instructions: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

9040.name: 靠墙冲刺
instructions: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

9041.name: 史密斯前腿垫高分腿蹲
9041.englishName: smith front leg elevated split squat
instructions: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

9042.name: 史密斯垫高分腿蹲
instructions: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

9043.name: 悬垂团身前水平保持
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.

9044.name: 悬垂进阶团身前水平保持
9044.englishName: hanging advanced tucked front lever hold
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

9045.name: 悬垂前水平保持
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.

9047.name: 稳定球直髋单腿腿弯举
9047.englishName: straight hip single leg curl on stability ball
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Keep your hips high.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

9048.name: 登山者交叉踢
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

9049.name: 上斜抬髋
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

9066.name: 四向单腿跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.

9068.name: 跳箱落下双脚着地
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.

9070.name: 弹跳双脚
instructions: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.

9161.name: 椅上坐姿侧弯
9161.englishName: sitting side bend on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.

9180.name: 木棒站姿肩部后伸活动度练习
9180.englishName: stick standing shoulder mobilization in extension
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9181.name: 木棒站姿肩部外旋活动度练习
9181.englishName: stick standing shoulder mobilization in external rotation
instructions: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

9184.name: 木棒肩部外展活动度练习
instructions: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.

9185.name: 绳索站姿交替肩屈曲
9185.englishName: standing alternating shoulder flexion with rope
instructions: Stand tall holding a rope in one hand at your side.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height or above.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms each rep.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

9187.name: 木棒站姿前平举
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.

9212.name: 睡姿肩部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

9213.name: 哑铃地面仰卧直臂推
9213.englishName: dumbbell lying straight arm press on floor
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.

9246.name: 宽站距胸椎旋转
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.

9248.name: 前后滑步
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.

9272.name: 坐姿地面提胫骨
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.

9304.name: 绳索中立握宽距下拉 v. 3
9304.englishName: cable neutral grip wide pulldown v. 3
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.

9310.name: 站姿等长保持提踵
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.

9311.name: 等长保持宽距俯卧撑
9311.englishName: isometric hold wide hand push up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

9312.name: 高杠上斜俯卧撑
instructions: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.

9313.name: 吊环等长保持反向腹轮滚动
9313.englishName: ring isometric hold reverse ab rollout
instructions: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Return slowly.

9314.name: 45度髋伸展(臀部专注) v. 2
9314.englishName: 45 degree hip extension glute focused v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.

9315.name: 垫高分腿蹲
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9316.name: 吊环垫高屈体俯卧撑(深度)
9316.englishName: ring elevated pike push up from deficit
instructions: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

9317.name: 坐姿等长保持引体向上
instructions: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

9318.name: 仰卧地面离心龙旗
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

9319.name: 仰卧地面离心半龙旗
9319.englishName: lying floor negative half dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

9320.name: 等长保持窄握反手引体向上
9320.englishName: isometric hold close grip chin up
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.

9321.name: 仰卧地面水平打水腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

9322.name: 仰卧地面单腿离心龙旗
9322.englishName: lying floor single leg negative dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.

9323.name: 宽凳空气深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

9324.name: 长杠杆站姿髋伸展
instructions: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

9325.name: 等长保持俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.

9359.name: 单腿腘绳肌臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9385.name: 史密斯jm卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows slightly in.
Press the bar back up.
Use a light weight and control the path.

9387.name: 杠杆式斜角单腿腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9398.name: 杠杆式站姿蝴蝶机夹胸
instructions: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.

9408.name: 连续小跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.

9409.name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝提踵
9409.englishName: standing bent knee calf raise with a chair support
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

9410.name: 杠铃站姿屈膝垫高提踵
9410.englishName: barbell standing bent knee calf raise from deficit
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low platform.
Soften your knees into a slight bend and keep that angle throughout.
Lower your heels below the platform until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.

9411.name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝交替提踵
9411.englishName: standing bent knee alternating calf raise with a chair support
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.

9451.name: 仰卧地面6英寸保持
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.

9484.name: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.

9485.name: 壶铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.

9486.name: 碗式保持
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

9487.name: 坐姿地面抬腿
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.

9488.name: 屈体站立
instructions: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

9489.name: 悬垂侧倾
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.

9490.name: 登箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9491.name: 绳索侧卧单臂侧平举
9491.englishName: cable side lying single arm lateral raise
instructions: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

9492.name: 绳索仰卧直立划船(曲杆)
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grip the SZ bar.
Start with arms extended over your thighs.
Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.

9493.name: 杠杆式腰带相扑深蹲
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand with a wide stance, toes out.
Keep your chest tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit down between your legs.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

9494.name: 杠杆式腰带罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Wear the belt and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat with smooth control.

9503.name: 悬挂带后三角肌划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

9509.name: 杠杆式坐姿脚尖抬起
instructions: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9510.name: 搭档辅助引体向上
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.

9511.name: 箱子辅助引体向上
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

9512.name: 箱子单腿辅助引体向上
9512.englishName: box single leg assisted pull up
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

9513.name: 反向动作跳摆臂
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

9514.name: 反向动作跳双手叉腰
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.

9515.name: 哑铃坐姿早安式体前屈
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.

9516.name: 杠铃垫高脚跟高翻握法深蹲
9516.englishName: barbell elevated heel clean grip squat
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

9517.name: 负重壶铃死虫式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.

9518.name: 壶铃上拉死虫式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
Switch sides and repeat.

9600.name: 墙角胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

9601.name: 徒手帕特里克步
instructions: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9602.name: 徒手箱上帕特里克步
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9603.name: 徒手波利金步
instructions: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9604.name: 徒手箱上波利金步
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9605.name: 徒手彼得森步(箱上)
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9606.name: 跳箱落地跳
instructions: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.

9607.name: 等长大腿中段拉
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.

9608.name: 跑步机倒退走
instructions: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.

9609.name: 壶铃硬拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.

9610.name: 杠铃片过头前弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9611.name: 徒手过头前弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9612.name: 哑铃跨箱
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.

9653.name: 站姿躯干扭转甩臂
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.

9676.name: 杠杆式仰卧屈膝
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

9677.name: 平板支撑侧跳
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.

9679.name: 跳跃高抬膝触碰
instructions: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Keep your chest upright.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.

9690.name: 哑铃脚跟垫高前蹲
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up to stand.

9691.name: 徒手脚跟垫高前蹲
instructions: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.

9692.name: 壶铃交替单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Press the other arm on the next rep.

9693.name: 哑铃交替单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Alternate arms each rep.

9694.name: 杠铃半跪肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9695.name: 地雷管半跪肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

9696.name: 杠铃蛙式站姿硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar with control.

9697.name: 壶铃倒握单臂过头负重行走
9697.englishName: kettlebell bottoms up single arm overhead carry
instructions: Clean a kettlebell so it is upside down with the bell above your fist.
Press it overhead with a firm wrist.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk slowly in a straight line.
Lower it safely and switch arms.

9698.name: 哑铃胸部支撑划船
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

9699.name: 哑铃单臂胸部支撑划船
9699.englishName: dumbbell single arm chest supported row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

9700.name: 徒手行走低位弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

9701.name: 长距离弓步蹲(低位弓步)
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

9702.name: 徒手脉冲高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.

9703.name: 壶铃z式推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

9704.name: 悬挂带头倒立
instructions: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

9705.name: 绳索仰卧地面前平举
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

9724.name: 绳索俯身单臂中立握后踢(绳索把手)
9724.englishName: cable bent over single arm neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9736.name: 三头肌臂屈伸(腿放凳上)
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，然后伸直手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

9739.name: 绳索下压
instructions: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向下推，直到肘部完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

9760.name: 跪姿肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel in a plank position with straight arms.
Keep your elbows locked.
Let your chest sink by pinching your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread them apart.
Keep your core braced.

9803.name: 站姿靠墙提胫骨
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9819.name: 悬垂屈膝抬腿
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9821.name: 平板支撑抬腿登山者
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.

9848.name: 杠杆式站姿髋推
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down.

9849.name: 侧平板蚌式开合
instructions: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

9862.name: 杠杆式单臂牧师凳弯举(插片式)
9862.englishName: lever single arm preacher curl (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9863.name: 绳索侧卧地面单腿后踢
9863.englishName: cable side lying floor single leg kickback
instructions: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

9865.name: 杠杆式腰带硬拉(V形杠)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

9866.name: 杠杆式腰带硬拉(直杠)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

9867.name: 绳索45度反握反向飞鸟
9867.englishName: cable 45 degrees reverse grip reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

9868.name: 绳索45度单臂反向飞鸟
9868.englishName: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

9869.name: 绳索45度单臂反握反向飞鸟
9869.englishName: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse grip reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle with your palm up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

9870.name: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(背部支撑)
9870.englishName: cable incline single arm y raise with back support
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a cable handle in one hand.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause with your thumb up.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9871.name: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(腕带,背部支撑)
9871.englishName: cable incline single arm y raise wrist straps with back support
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9872.name: 绳索卧凳交叉侧平举
9872.englishName: cable lying bench cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.

9873.name: 绳索卧凳单臂交叉侧平举
9873.englishName: cable lying bench single arm cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

9874.name: 绳索仰卧单臂交叉侧平举
9874.englishName: cable lying single arm cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

9875.name: 绳索坐凳单臂转体划船
9875.englishName: cable sitting bench single arm twisting row
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.

9876.name: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(直杆)
instructions: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.

9877.name: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(V型杆)
instructions: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

9878.name: 绳索泽奇深蹲
instructions: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest.
Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked and the load close to your body.

9890.name: 站姿骨盆抬升
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

9927.name: 绳索仰卧上斜侧抬腿
9927.englishName: cable lying incline side leg raise
instructions: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

9928.name: 绳索仰卧上斜单腿后踢
9928.englishName: cable lying incline single leg kickback
instructions: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9929.name: 哈克深蹲机单腿深蹲(杠杆)
9929.englishName: leverage single leg squat on hack squat machine
instructions: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

9930.name: 杠铃加州推举
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.

9931.name: 哑铃蜘蛛弯举
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

9932.name: 杠铃弹力带负重杠铃片卧推
9932.englishName: barbell banded weighted plate bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.

9933.name: 哑铃坐姿交替侧平举
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.

9939.name: 动力雪橇拉
instructions: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.

9940.name: 负重沙袋前弓步
instructions: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.

9942.name: 站姿交叉腿核心拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

9969.name: 仰卧足跟滑动
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.

9971.name: 仰卧直膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9977.name: 仰卧腹式呼吸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.

9980.name: 木棍辅助站姿肩前屈
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

9986.name: 站姿毛巾足部卷腹
instructions: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.

9988.name: 弹力带跪姿西西深蹲
instructions: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.

9989.name: 木棍辅助站姿肩内旋
9989.englishName: stick assisted standing shoulder internal rotation
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.

9990.name: 站姿靠墙肩内旋等长收缩
9990.englishName: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

9994.name: 球辅助仰卧屈膝髋内收等长收缩
9994.englishName: ball assisted lying bent knee isometric hip adduction
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.

9995.name: 腕伸展等长收缩
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.

9996.name: 弹力带拇指伸展等长收缩
instructions: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.

9999.name: 平板支撑触膝
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

10003.name: 弹力带坐地踝背屈
10003.englishName: resistance band sitting floor ankle dorsi flexion
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.

10014.name: 球辅助仰卧髋内收
10014.englishName: ball assisted lying supine hip adduction
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.

10031.name: 伸拇指时手指屈曲
instructions: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

10032.name: 拇指外展
instructions: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

10038.name: 哑铃腕旋后
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

10040.name: 哑铃站姿交替交叉举
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

10041.name: 哑铃侧平板支撑 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.

10042.name: 哑铃仰卧地面挤压推举
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

10043.name: 哑铃单臂z字推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

10044.name: 哑铃悬垂抓举
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

10045.name: 面朝下雪天使
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

10046.name: 面朝上雪天使
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

10047.name: 杠铃分腿站姿RDL
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10048.name: 绳索踏阶
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10049.name: 杠铃蝴蝶式z字推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.

10050.name: 超人式转俯卧撑
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

10051.name: 徒手窄距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

10052.name: 地雷杆哥萨克深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.

10053.name: 坐姿起跳
instructions: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

10054.name: 杠铃静态弓步蹲
instructions: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10055.name: 哑铃窄距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

10056.name: 地雷杆弹力带推举
instructions: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

10057.name: 桌面桥开合跳
instructions: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

10058.name: 交替跪姿到半跪姿
instructions: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

10065.name: 杠杆躯干旋转
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.

10092.name: 杠铃核心深蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.

10093.name: 哑铃半跪姿雷神上举
instructions: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

10094.name: 哑铃站姿交叉高翻
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

10095.name: 绳索单臂熊式飞鸟
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.

10096.name: 哑铃后撤弓步蹲转单臂肩部推举
10096.englishName: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

10097.name: 负重杠铃片侧向起身深蹲
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
